```{r}
  source_mouse = seed_mouse_source,
  mouse_symbol = seed_mouse_query
)

  unique(seed_mouse_query),
  species = "mouse",
  human = FALSE,
  min_support = 1,
  top = FALSE
)

  filter(!is.na(human_symbol), human_symbol != "", support_n >= 3) %>%
  group_by(symbol) %>%
  filter(support_n == max(support_n, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  distinct(symbol, human_symbol, .keep_all = TRUE)

  left_join(seed_map_best, by = c("mouse_symbol" = "symbol")) %>%
  filter(!is.na(human_symbol), human_symbol != "") %>%
  transmute(
    source_mouse = source_mouse,
    mouse_symbol = mouse_symbol,
    human_symbol = human_symbol,
    human_entrez = human_entrez,
    human_ensembl = human_ensembl,
    support_n = support_n,
    support = support,
    mapping_source = "babelgene"
  )

  mapping_source = c("NCBI_manual", "NCBI_manual", "NCBI_manual")

  unique(seed_reference_auto$source_mouse)

seed_reference <- bind_rows(
  seed_reference_auto,
  seed_reference_manual %>% filter(source_mouse %in% missing_after_auto)
```

```{r}
  "data/GSE145197_RAW/GSM4308343_UMI_tab_ZT00A.txt.gz",
  "data/GSE145197_RAW/GSM4308344_UMI_tab_ZT00B.txt.gz",
  "data/GSE145197_RAW/GSM4308345_UMI_tab_ZT00C.txt.gz",
  "data/GSE145197_RAW/GSM4308346_UMI_tab_ZT06A.txt.gz",
  "data/GSE145197_RAW/GSM4308347_UMI_tab_ZT06B.txt.gz",
  "data/GSE145197_RAW/GSM4308348_UMI_tab_ZT12A.txt.gz",
  "data/GSE145197_RAW/GSM4308349_UMI_tab_ZT12B.txt.gz",
  "data/GSE145197_RAW/GSM4308350_UMI_tab_ZT12C.txt.gz",
  "data/GSE145197_RAW/GSM4308351_UMI_tab_ZT18A.txt.gz",
  "data/GSE145197_RAW/GSM4308352_UMI_tab_ZT18B.txt.gz"
)

stopifnot(all(file.exists(files)))

read_umi <- function(f) {
  x <- data.table::fread(f, data.table = FALSE, check.names = FALSE)
  ids <- as.character(x[[1]])
  m <- as.matrix(x[, -1, drop = FALSE])
  storage.mode(m) <- "numeric"

  if (nrow(m) >= ncol(m)) {
    rownames(m) <- ids
  } else {
    cell_ids <- ids
    gene_ids <- colnames(m)
    m <- t(m)
    rownames(m) <- gene_ids
    colnames(m) <- cell_ids
  }

  sample_id <- sub("_UMI_tab_.*$", "", basename(f))
  zt_label <- sub("^.*_UMI_tab_(ZT[0-9]+[A-Z])\\.txt\\.gz$", "\\1", basename(f))
  zt <- as.numeric(sub("^ZT([0-9]+)[A-Z]$", "\\1", zt_label))
  replicate <- sub("^ZT[0-9]+", "", zt_label)

  if (is.null(colnames(m))) colnames(m) <- paste0("Cell_", seq_len(ncol(m)))
  colnames(m) <- paste(sample_id, colnames(m), sep = "_")

  m <- Matrix::Matrix(m, sparse = TRUE)

  meta <- data.frame(
    cell = colnames(m),
    sample = sample_id,
    ZT = zt,
    replicate = replicate,
    celltype = "Hepatocyte",
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )

  message(sample_id, " | ZT=", zt, " | ", nrow(m), " genes x ", ncol(m), " cells")
  list(count = m, meta = meta)
}

dat_list <- lapply(files, read_umi)

all_genes <- unique(unlist(lapply(dat_list, function(x) rownames(x$count))))

expand_matrix <- function(m, genes) {
  sm <- summary(m)
  i_new <- match(rownames(m)[sm$i], genes)
  Matrix::sparseMatrix(
    i = i_new,
    j = sm$j,
    x = sm$x,
    dims = c(length(genes), ncol(m)),
    dimnames = list(genes, colnames(m))
  )
}

count_list <- lapply(dat_list, function(x) expand_matrix(x$count, all_genes))
```

## min_seed detectability sensitivit
```{r true-min-seed}
for (dataset in names(true_counts)) {
  true_phase[[dataset]] <- list()
  true_seed_diagnostics[[dataset]] <- list()
  true_seed_genes[[dataset]] <- list()
  for (threshold in min_seed_values) {
    fit <- infer_cell_phase(
      count = true_counts[[dataset]], metadata = true_meta[[dataset]],
      ZT_by = "ZT_num", strata_by = "celltype",
      seedgene = NULL, Species = "mouse", min_seed = threshold,
      family = "Poisson", n_grid = 60, n_iter_outer = 5, n_iter_seed = 3,
      setseed = 1, Verbose = TRUE
    )
    key <- as.character(threshold)
    true_phase[[dataset]][[key]] <- fit
    true_seed_genes[[dataset]][[key]] <- attr(fit, "seed_genes")
    true_seed_diagnostics[[dataset]][[key]] <- attr(fit, "seed_diagnostics")
    stopifnot(length(attr(fit, "seed_genes")) > 0,
              !is.null(attr(fit, "seed_diagnostics")))
  }
}
```

##circular phase stability
```{r true-comparison-function}
seed_stability <- function(ref, fit) {
  stopifnot(!anyDuplicated(ref$cell), !anyDuplicated(fit$cell),
            setequal(ref$cell, fit$cell))
  fit <- fit[match(ref$cell, fit$cell), ]
  stopifnot(identical(ref$cell, fit$cell),
            all(is.finite(ref$theta_pred)), all(is.finite(fit$theta_pred)))
  delta <- atan2(sin(fit$theta_pred - ref$theta_pred),
                 cos(fit$theta_pred - ref$theta_pred))
  groups <- c(list(all_cells = seq_len(nrow(ref))),
              split(seq_len(nrow(ref)), paste0("celltype:", ref$stratum)))
  rows <- list()
  for (group in names(groups)) {
    i <- groups[[group]]
    rows[[group]] <- data.frame(
      group = group, n_cell = length(i),
      median_abs_diff_h = median(abs(delta[i])) * 24 / (2 * pi),
      mean_abs_diff_h = mean(abs(delta[i])) * 24 / (2 * pi),
      p90_abs_diff_h = unname(quantile(abs(delta[i]), 0.9)) * 24 / (2 * pi),
      circular_agreement = mean(cos(delta[i])),
      median_Rbar_ref = median(ref$Rbar[i]), median_Rbar = median(fit$Rbar[i]),
      median_r_cell_ref = median(ref$r_cell[i]), median_r_cell = median(fit$r_cell[i])
    )
  }
  do.call(rbind, rows)
}

true_min_seed_summary <- list()
true_min_seed_comparison <- list()
for (dataset in names(true_phase)) {
  for (threshold in min_seed_values) {
    fit <- true_phase[[dataset]][[as.character(threshold)]]
    diag <- attr(fit, "seed_diagnostics")
    key <- paste(dataset, threshold, sep = "_")
    true_min_seed_summary[[key]] <- data.frame(
      dataset = dataset, min_seed = threshold, n_reference = 104,
      n_matched = nrow(diag), n_retained = length(attr(fit, "seed_genes")),
      median_Rbar = median(fit$Rbar), median_r_cell = median(fit$r_cell)
    )
  }
  pairs <- combn(as.character(min_seed_values), 2)
  for (j in seq_len(ncol(pairs))) {
    ref <- true_phase[[dataset]][[pairs[1, j]]]
    fit <- true_phase[[dataset]][[pairs[2, j]]]
    key <- paste(dataset, pairs[1, j], pairs[2, j], sep = "_")
    true_min_seed_comparison[[key]] <- cbind(
      dataset = dataset, min_seed_ref = as.numeric(pairs[1, j]),
      min_seed_test = as.numeric(pairs[2, j]), seed_stability(ref, fit)
    )
  }
}
true_min_seed_summary <- do.call(rbind, true_min_seed_summary)
true_min_seed_comparison <- do.call(rbind, true_min_seed_comparison)
true_min_seed_summary
true_min_seed_comparison
```

## Seed-number sensitivity
```{r true-seed-number}
true_number_phase <- list()
true_number_panels <- list()
true_number_summary <- list()
n_seed_repeat <- 10

for (dataset in names(true_counts)) {
  ref <- true_phase[[dataset]][["0.01"]]
  pool <- attr(ref, "seed_genes")
  K_values <- sort(unique(c(c(10, 20, 30, 50, 75)[c(10, 20, 30, 50, 75) <= length(pool)], length(pool))))
  for (replicate in seq_len(n_seed_repeat)) {
    set.seed(1000 + replicate)
    pool_order <- sample(pool, length(pool), replace = FALSE)
    for (K in K_values) {
      panel <- pool[pool %in% pool_order[seq_len(K)]]
      if (K == length(pool)) {
        fit <- ref
      } else {
        fit <- infer_cell_phase(
          count = true_counts[[dataset]], metadata = true_meta[[dataset]],
          ZT_by = "ZT_num", strata_by = "celltype",
          seedgene = panel, Species = "mouse", min_seed = 0,
          family = "Poisson", n_grid = 60, n_iter_outer = 5, n_iter_seed = 3,
          setseed = 1, Verbose = TRUE
        )
      }
      stopifnot(setequal(attr(fit, "seed_genes"), panel))
      key <- paste(dataset, replicate, K, sep = "_")
      true_number_phase[[key]] <- fit
      true_number_panels[[key]] <- panel
      true_number_summary[[key]] <- cbind(
        dataset = dataset, replicate = replicate, sampling_seed = 1000 + replicate,
        K = K, n_pool = length(pool), all_seeds = K == length(pool),
        seed_stability(ref, fit)
      )
    }
  }
}
true_number_summary <- do.call(rbind, true_number_summary)
true_number_summary
```

## Seed-mismatch robustness
```{r true-seed-mismatch}
true_mismatch_phase <- list()
true_mismatch_panels <- list()
true_mismatch_summary <- list()
mismatch_fractions <- c(0, 0.10, 0.25, 0.50)

for (dataset in names(true_counts)) {
  ref <- true_phase[[dataset]][["0.01"]]
  panel <- attr(ref, "seed_genes")
  all_reference <- attr(true_phase[[dataset]][["0"]], "seed_genes")
  excluded <- unique(c(tolower(all_reference), "arntl", "bmal1", "h1f2", "hist1h1c", "noct", "ccrn4l"))
  detect <- Matrix::rowMeans(true_counts[[dataset]] > 0)
  non_reference <- names(detect)[detect >= 0.01 & !tolower(names(detect)) %in% excluded]
  non_reference <- non_reference[!duplicated(tolower(non_reference))]
  max_replace <- floor(max(mismatch_fractions) * length(panel))
  stopifnot(length(non_reference) >= max_replace)

  for (replicate in seq_len(n_seed_repeat)) {
    set.seed(2000 + replicate)
    replace_order <- sample(seq_along(panel), length(panel), replace = FALSE)
    replacement_order <- sample(non_reference, max_replace, replace = FALSE)
    for (fraction in mismatch_fractions) {
      n_replace <- floor(fraction * length(panel))
      removed <- panel[replace_order[seq_len(n_replace)]]
      added <- replacement_order[seq_len(n_replace)]
      test_panel <- c(panel[!panel %in% removed], added)
      if (n_replace == 0) {
        fit <- ref
      } else {
        fit <- infer_cell_phase(
          count = true_counts[[dataset]], metadata = true_meta[[dataset]],
          ZT_by = "ZT_num", strata_by = "celltype",
          seedgene = test_panel, Species = "mouse", min_seed = 0,
          family = "Poisson", n_grid = 60, n_iter_outer = 5, n_iter_seed = 3,
          setseed = 1, Verbose = TRUE
        )
      }
      stopifnot(length(attr(fit, "seed_genes")) == length(panel),
                setequal(attr(fit, "seed_genes"), test_panel))
      key <- paste(dataset, replicate, fraction, sep = "_")
      true_mismatch_phase[[key]] <- fit
      true_mismatch_panels[[key]] <- list(reference = panel, removed = removed,
                                         added = added, requested = test_panel,
                                         retained = attr(fit, "seed_genes"))
      true_mismatch_summary[[key]] <- cbind(
        dataset = dataset, replicate = replicate, sampling_seed = 2000 + replicate,
        requested_fraction = fraction, actual_fraction = n_replace / length(panel),
        n_seed = length(panel), n_replace = n_replace,
        seed_stability(ref, fit)
      )
    }
  }
}
true_mismatch_summary <- do.call(rbind, true_mismatch_summary)
true_mismatch_summary
```

## 1. Read 6CT simulation
```{r read-data}
count <- as(readMM(file.path(input_dir, "count_gene_by_cell.mtx")), "CsparseMatrix")
genes <- read.csv(file.path(input_dir, "genes.csv"), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
metadata <- read.csv(file.path(input_dir, "metadata.csv"), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

meta_cols <- c("cell", "sample_name", "ZT", "celltype", "sigma_bio_hour", "T_true", "Theta_true")

stopifnot(all(meta_cols %in% names(metadata)))
stopifnot("gene" %in% names(genes))
stopifnot(nrow(count) == nrow(genes))
stopifnot(ncol(count) == nrow(metadata))
stopifnot(!anyDuplicated(metadata$cell))
stopifnot(!anyDuplicated(genes$gene))
stopifnot(all(is.finite(count@x)))
stopifnot(all(count@x >= 0))
stopifnot(all(count@x == round(count@x)))

rownames(count) <- genes$gene
colnames(count) <- metadata$cell
rownames(metadata) <- metadata$cell

metadata <- metadata[match(colnames(count), metadata$cell), , drop = FALSE]

stopifnot(identical(colnames(count), metadata$cell))

dim(count)
table(metadata$celltype)
```

## 2. scRhythmBayes cell phase
```{r infer-cell-phase,message=TRUE}
source("support/legacy/infer_cell_phase.R")
res_phase <- infer_cell_phase(
  count = count,
  metadata = metadata,
  ZT_by = "ZT",
  strata_by = "celltype",
  Species = "mouse",
  min_seed = 0.01,
  family = "NB",
  setseed = 1,
  Verbose = TRUE
)

stopifnot(all(c("cell", "ZT_pred", "theta_pred", "Rbar", "r_cell") %in% names(res_phase)))
stopifnot(!anyDuplicated(res_phase$cell))
stopifnot(setequal(metadata$cell, res_phase$cell))

res_phase <- res_phase[match(metadata$cell, res_phase$cell), , drop = FALSE]

stopifnot(identical(as.character(res_phase$cell), metadata$cell))

cat("Candidate seeds:", attr(res_phase, "n_seed_candidate"), "\n")
cat("Matched seeds:", attr(res_phase, "n_seed_matched"), "\n")
cat("Retained seeds:", attr(res_phase, "n_seed_retained"), "\n")
cat("min_seed:", attr(res_phase, "min_seed"), "\n")
cat("family:", attr(res_phase, "family"), "\n")

print(attr(res_phase, "seed_genes"))
```

## 3.Save SRB result
```{r zt-only}
SRB_cell_phase <- metadata[, meta_cols]

SRB_cell_phase$pred_hour <- res_phase$ZT_pred %% 24
SRB_cell_phase$pred_rad <- res_phase$theta_pred %% (2*pi)
SRB_cell_phase$Rbar <- res_phase$Rbar
SRB_cell_phase$r_cell <- res_phase$r_cell
SRB_cell_phase$wrapped_error_hour <- wrap_hour(SRB_cell_phase$pred_hour - SRB_cell_phase$T_true)
SRB_cell_phase$abs_error_hour <- abs(SRB_cell_phase$wrapped_error_hour)

stopifnot(all(is.finite(SRB_cell_phase$pred_hour)))
stopifnot(all(is.finite(SRB_cell_phase$pred_rad)))

write.csv(SRB_cell_phase, file.path(output_dir, "SRB_cell_phase.csv"), row.names = FALSE)

head(SRB_cell_phase)
srb_seed_settings <- data.frame(
  n_seed_candidate = attr(res_phase, "n_seed_candidate"),
  n_seed_matched = attr(res_phase, "n_seed_matched"),
  n_seed_retained = attr(res_phase, "n_seed_retained"),
  min_seed = attr(res_phase, "min_seed"),
  family = attr(res_phase, "family"),
  seed_genes = paste(attr(res_phase, "seed_genes"), collapse = ";")
)

write.csv(
  srb_seed_settings,
  file.path(output_dir, "SRB_seed_settings.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)

write.csv(
  attr(res_phase, "seed_diagnostics"),
  file.path(output_dir, "SRB_seed_diagnostics.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)
```

## 5.scRhythmBayes true vs predicted phase
```{r}
df_srb <- data.frame(true = SRB_cell_phase$T_true %% 24, pred = SRB_cell_phase$pred_hour %% 24)

color_point <- "#A8C7E6"
color_diag <- "gray55"
color_band2 <- "#F7DDE3"
color_band4 <- "#FCECEF"

x_seq <- seq(-6, 30, length.out = 1000)

ribbon_data <- expand.grid(x = x_seq, offset = c(-24, 0, 24))

ribbon_data$y <- ribbon_data$x + ribbon_data$offset
ribbon_data$y_low2 <- ribbon_data$y - 2
ribbon_data$y_high2 <- ribbon_data$y + 2
ribbon_data$y_low4 <- ribbon_data$y - 4
ribbon_data$y_high4 <- ribbon_data$y + 4

p_srb <- ggplot(df_srb, aes(x = true, y = pred)) +
  geom_ribbon(data = ribbon_data, aes(x = x, ymin = y_low4, ymax = y_low2, group = offset), fill = color_band4, inherit.aes = FALSE) +
  geom_ribbon(data = ribbon_data, aes(x = x, ymin = y_low2, ymax = y_high2, group = offset), fill = color_band2, inherit.aes = FALSE) +
  geom_ribbon(data = ribbon_data, aes(x = x, ymin = y_high2, ymax = y_high4, group = offset), fill = color_band4, inherit.aes = FALSE) +
  geom_abline(intercept = 0, slope = 1, linetype = "dashed", color = color_diag, linewidth = 0.45) +
  geom_abline(intercept = 24, slope = 1, linetype = "dashed", color = color_diag, linewidth = 0.45) +
  geom_abline(intercept = -24, slope = 1, linetype = "dashed", color = color_diag, linewidth = 0.45) +
  geom_point(size = 0.65, color = color_point, alpha = 0.60) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 24, 2), expand = c(0, 0)) +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 24, 2), expand = c(0, 0)) +
  coord_fixed(ratio = 1, xlim = c(0, 24), ylim = c(0, 24), expand = FALSE, clip = "on") +
  labs(x = "True Time (h)", y = "Predicted Time (h)", title = "ZT_scRhythmBayes") +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(
    text = element_text(family = "Times New Roman"),
    plot.title = element_text(size = 15, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 13, face = "bold"),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 9, color = "black"),
    axis.line = element_line(color = "black", linewidth = 0.5),
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA)
  )

p_srb

ggsave(file.path(output_dir, "FigureC_ZT_scRhythmBayes.png"), p_srb, width = 4, height = 4, dpi = 600, bg = "white")
ggsave(file.path(output_dir, "FigureC_ZT_scRhythmBayes.pdf"), p_srb, width = 4, height = 4, device = cairo_pdf, bg = "white")
```

```{r}
reCAT_file <- path.expand("outputs/cell_phase/reCAT_6CT/reCAT_6CT_cell_phase.csv")

reCAT_cell_phase$pred_rad <- reCAT_cell_phase$reCAT_phase_rad
```

##23. Unified cell-phase benchmark
```{r}
suppressPackageStartupMessages({library(Matrix); library(dplyr); library(tidyr); library(ggplot2); library(plotthis)})

input_dir <- "outputs/simulation/output/scRITMO_extended_simulation/sigma_gradient_1p5_2p5_3p5_4p5_5p5_6p5_empirical_fixed_v1/R_input"
output_dir <- file.path(input_dir,"cell_phase_benchmark_SRB_ZT")
dir.create(output_dir,recursive=TRUE,showWarnings=FALSE)

metadata <- read.csv(file.path(input_dir,"metadata.csv"),stringsAsFactors=FALSE)
stopifnot(all(c("cell","sample_name","ZT","celltype","sigma_bio_hour","T_true","Theta_true") %in% names(metadata)),!anyDuplicated(metadata$cell),nrow(metadata)==9000)

wrap_hour <- function(x) (x+12)%%24-12
read_phase <- function(path,pred_col="pred_hour"){x <- read.csv(path,stringsAsFactors=FALSE); stopifnot("cell" %in% names(x),pred_col %in% names(x)); x <- x[match(metadata$cell,x$cell),,drop=FALSE]; stopifnot(identical(metadata$cell,x$cell)); x$pred_hour <- x[[pred_col]]; x}

method_order <- c("ZT-only","scRhythmBayes","scRITMO","Tempo","CoPhaser","CYCLOPS","reCAT","Cyclum","scPrisma")
method_colors <- c("ZT-only"="#E6E1DD","scRhythmBayes"="#A8C7E6","scRITMO"="#BFD8CC","Tempo"="#F3B0AC","CoPhaser"="#F4C9A8","CYCLOPS"="#D9A3AE","reCAT"="#78B9B4","Cyclum"="#C7B7D8","scPrisma"="#D7B6D5")
truth_color <- "#FBC600"

ZT_only_cell_phase <- read_phase(file.path(output_dir,"ZT_only_cell_phase.csv"))
SRB_cell_phase <- read_phase(file.path(output_dir,"SRB_cell_phase.csv"))
scRITMO_cell_phase <- read_phase(file.path(input_dir,"cell_phase_benchmark_scRITMO","scRITMO_cell_phase.csv"))
Tempo_cell_phase <- read_phase(file.path(input_dir,"cell_phase_benchmark_Tempo","Tempo_cell_phase.csv"))
CoPhaser_cell_phase <- read_phase(file.path(input_dir,"cell_phase_benchmark_CoPhaser","CoPhaser_cell_phase.csv"))
CYCLOPS_cell_phase <- read_phase(file.path(input_dir,"cell_phase_benchmark_CYCLOPS","CYCLOPS_cell_phase.csv"))
reCAT_cell_phase <- read_phase(path.expand("outputs/cell_phase/reCAT_6CT/reCAT_6CT_cell_phase.csv"),"reCAT_phase_hour")
Cyclum_cell_phase <- read_phase(file.path(input_dir,"cell_phase_benchmark_Cyclum_by_CT","Cyclum_cell_phase.csv"))
scPrisma_cell_phase <- read_phase(file.path(input_dir,"cell_phase_benchmark_scPrisma_by_CT","scPrisma_cell_phase.csv"))

phase_results <- list(
  "ZT-only"=ZT_only_cell_phase,
  "scRhythmBayes"=SRB_cell_phase,
  "scRITMO"=scRITMO_cell_phase,
  "Tempo"=Tempo_cell_phase,
  "CoPhaser"=CoPhaser_cell_phase,
  "CYCLOPS"=CYCLOPS_cell_phase,
  "reCAT"=reCAT_cell_phase,
  "Cyclum"=Cyclum_cell_phase,
  "scPrisma"=scPrisma_cell_phase
)

benchmark_long <- bind_rows(lapply(names(phase_results),function(m) data.frame(cell=metadata$cell,celltype=metadata$celltype,sigma_bio_hour=metadata$sigma_bio_hour,ZT=metadata$ZT,T_true=metadata$T_true,method=m,pred_hour=phase_results[[m]]$pred_hour))) %>% mutate(method=factor(method,levels=method_order),celltype=factor(celltype,levels=paste0("CT",1:6)),wrapped_error_hour=wrap_hour(pred_hour-T_true),abs_error_hour=abs(wrapped_error_hour))

stopifnot(nrow(benchmark_long)==nrow(metadata)*length(method_order))
print(dim(benchmark_long))
print(table(benchmark_long$method,useNA="ifany"))

benchmark_summary <- benchmark_long %>% group_by(method) %>% summarise(N_total=n(),N_predicted=sum(is.finite(pred_hour)),Coverage=mean(is.finite(pred_hour)),MAE=mean(abs_error_hour,na.rm=TRUE),MedAE=median(abs_error_hour,na.rm=TRUE),RMSE=sqrt(mean(wrapped_error_hour^2,na.rm=TRUE)),Within2h=mean(abs_error_hour<=2,na.rm=TRUE),Within4h=mean(abs_error_hour<=4,na.rm=TRUE),.groups="drop") %>% arrange(MAE) %>% mutate(Rank_MAE=row_number())

benchmark_by_celltype <- benchmark_long %>% group_by(method,celltype,sigma_bio_hour) %>% summarise(N_total=n(),N_predicted=sum(is.finite(pred_hour)),Coverage=mean(is.finite(pred_hour)),MAE=mean(abs_error_hour,na.rm=TRUE),MedAE=median(abs_error_hour,na.rm=TRUE),RMSE=sqrt(mean(wrapped_error_hour^2,na.rm=TRUE)),Within2h=mean(abs_error_hour<=2,na.rm=TRUE),Within4h=mean(abs_error_hour<=4,na.rm=TRUE),.groups="drop")

benchmark_by_ZT <- benchmark_long %>% group_by(method,celltype,sigma_bio_hour,ZT) %>% summarise(N_total=n(),N_predicted=sum(is.finite(pred_hour)),Coverage=mean(is.finite(pred_hour)),MAE=mean(abs_error_hour,na.rm=TRUE),MedAE=median(abs_error_hour,na.rm=TRUE),RMSE=sqrt(mean(wrapped_error_hour^2,na.rm=TRUE)),Within2h=mean(abs_error_hour<=2,na.rm=TRUE),Within4h=mean(abs_error_hour<=4,na.rm=TRUE),.groups="drop")

write.csv(benchmark_long,file.path(output_dir,"benchmark_master_long_unified.csv"),row.names=FALSE)
write.csv(benchmark_summary,file.path(output_dir,"benchmark_summary_unified.csv"),row.names=FALSE)
write.csv(benchmark_by_celltype,file.path(output_dir,"benchmark_metrics_by_celltype.csv"),row.names=FALSE)
write.csv(benchmark_by_ZT,file.path(output_dir,"benchmark_metrics_by_celltype_ZT.csv"),row.names=FALSE)

print(benchmark_summary)
```

## Figure 2B: circular cell-phase distribution
```{r}
## Figure 2B: circular cell-phase distribution
library(patchwork)
figure2B_methods <- figure_method_order
figure2B_method_colors <- figure_method_colors

figure2B_zt_colors <- c("ZT00"="#F08F8F","ZT04"="#F4BD7A","ZT08"="#D7D982","ZT12"="#8FC9A3","ZT16"="#79B9D5","ZT20"="#B19AD7")

figure2B_alg <- benchmark_long %>% transmute(cell=cell,celltype=celltype,ZT=ZT,Algorithm=as.character(method),Phase=pred_hour%%24)
figure2B_truth <- metadata %>% transmute(cell=cell,celltype=factor(celltype,levels=paste0("CT",1:6)),ZT=ZT,Algorithm="Ground Truth",Phase=T_true%%24)

figure2B_data <- bind_rows(figure2B_truth,figure2B_alg) %>% mutate(
  Algorithm=factor(Algorithm,levels=figure2B_methods),
  celltype=factor(celltype,levels=paste0("CT",1:6)),
  ZT_group=factor(sprintf("ZT%02d",ZT),levels=sprintf("ZT%02d",c(0,4,8,12,16,20))),
  ring=as.numeric(Algorithm)+5
)

figure2B_plot_data <- figure2B_data %>% filter(is.finite(Phase))

ring_df <- data.frame(
  Algorithm=factor(figure2B_methods,levels=figure2B_methods),
  ring=seq_along(figure2B_methods)+5,
  method_color=unname(figure2B_method_colors[figure2B_methods])
)

plot_fig2B_CT <- function(ct,show_legend=TRUE){

  set.seed(20260917)

  dat_ct <- figure2B_plot_data %>% filter(celltype==ct) %>% group_by(Algorithm) %>% slice_sample(prop=1) %>% ungroup()

  ggplot(dat_ct,aes(x=Phase,y=ring)) +
    geom_hline(data=ring_df,aes(yintercept=ring,colour=method_color),inherit.aes=FALSE,linewidth=0.55,alpha=0.22) +
    geom_point(aes(fill=ZT_group),shape=21,size=2.2,stroke=0,alpha=0.48,position=position_jitter(width=0,height=0.08,seed=20260917)) +
    geom_text(data=ring_df,aes(x=0.60,y=ring,label=Algorithm),inherit.aes=FALSE,colour="#333333",size=4.2,fontface="bold",hjust=0) +
    scale_colour_identity() +
    scale_fill_manual(values=figure2B_zt_colors,drop=FALSE) +
    scale_x_continuous(limits=c(0,24),breaks=c(0,4,8,12,16,20),labels=paste0(c(0,4,8,12,16,20),"h"),expand=c(0,0)) +
    scale_y_continuous(limits=c(5.4,15.7),breaks=NULL,expand=c(0,0)) +
    coord_polar(theta="x",start=0,direction=1,clip="off") +
    labs(fill="Sample ZT",title=ct) +
    guides(fill=guide_legend(ncol=1,byrow=TRUE,title.position="top",override.aes=list(shape=21,size=6,alpha=1,colour=NA))) +
    theme_minimal(base_size=16) +
    theme(
      text=element_text(family="Times New Roman"),
      plot.title=element_text(size=22,face="bold",hjust=0.5,margin=margin(b=5)),
      axis.title=element_blank(),
      axis.text.x=element_text(size=18,colour="#303030",face="bold"),
      axis.text.y=element_blank(),
      panel.grid.major.x=element_line(colour="#E5E5E5",linewidth=0.35),
      panel.grid.major.y=element_blank(),
      panel.grid.minor=element_blank(),
      legend.position=if(show_legend) "right" else "none",
      legend.direction="vertical",
      legend.box="vertical",
      legend.title=element_text(size=18.5,face="bold"),
      legend.text=element_text(size=18,face="bold"),
      legend.key.width=grid::unit(0.72,"cm"),
```

## Figure 2D: Absolute-error CDF in original Figure-2 style
```{r}
figure2D_methods <- c("scRhythmBayes","ZT-only","scRITMO","Tempo","CoPhaser","CYCLOPS","reCAT","Cyclum","scPrisma")

figure2D_colors <- c("scRhythmBayes"="#A8C7E6","ZT-only"="#8F8F8F","scRITMO"="#BFD8CC","Tempo"="#F3B0AC","CoPhaser"="#F4C9A8","CYCLOPS"="#D9A3AE","reCAT"="#78B9B4","Cyclum"="#C7B7D8","scPrisma"="#D7B6D5")
figure2D_colors <- c(
  "Ground Truth"="#FBC600",
  "scRhythmBayes"="#A64078",
  "scRITMO"="#6E87B0",
  "Tempo"="#B2C1D6",
  "CoPhaser"="#D3CDDA",
  "CYCLOPS"="#C6D0DF",
  "reCAT"="#C7B5CC",
  "Cyclum"="#DBBACB",
  "scPrisma"="#B99BB5",
  "ZT-only"="#BFD8CC"
)
figure2D_data <- benchmark_long %>% filter(is.finite(pred_hour),is.finite(abs_error_hour)) %>% mutate(method=factor(as.character(method),levels=figure2D_methods))

calculate_error_cdf <- function(df_method){err <- sort(df_method$abs_error_hour); xvals <- c(0,err,12); correct_pct <- vapply(xvals,function(x) 100*mean(err<=x),numeric(1)); x_norm <- xvals/12; y_norm <- correct_pct/100; auc <- sum(y_norm[-length(y_norm)]*diff(x_norm)); medae <- median(err); data.frame(x=xvals,correct_pct=correct_pct,AUC=auc,MedAE=medae)}

figure2D_cdf <- bind_rows(lapply(figure2D_methods,function(m){tmp <- figure2D_data %>% filter(method==m); out <- calculate_error_cdf(tmp); out$method <- m; out})) %>% mutate(method=factor(method,levels=figure2D_methods))

figure2D_metrics <- figure2D_cdf %>% group_by(method) %>% summarise(AUC=first(AUC),MedAE=first(MedAE),.groups="drop") %>% mutate(method=as.character(method)) %>% left_join(benchmark_summary %>% transmute(method=as.character(method),Coverage=Coverage),by="method") %>% mutate(method=factor(method,levels=figure2D_methods))

print(figure2D_metrics)

figure2D_metrics <- figure2D_metrics %>% mutate(label=ifelse(as.character(method)=="reCAT",sprintf("%s: %.3f, %.3f (%.1f%%)",method,AUC,MedAE,100*Coverage),sprintf("%s: %.3f, %.3f",method,AUC,MedAE)))

figure2D_labels <- setNames(figure2D_metrics$label,as.character(figure2D_metrics$method))

p_fig2D <- ggplot(
  figure2D_cdf,
  aes(
    x=x,
    y=correct_pct,
    colour=method,
    group=method
  )
) +
  geom_abline(
    intercept=0,
    slope=100/12,
    colour="#BDBDBD",
    linewidth=0.65,
    alpha=0.80
  ) +
  geom_step(
    linewidth=1.15,
    alpha=0.95
  ) +
  scale_colour_manual(
    values=figure2D_colors,
    breaks=figure2D_methods,
    labels=figure2D_labels,
    drop=FALSE
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    limits=c(0,12),
    breaks=seq(0,12,2),
    expand=c(0,0)
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    limits=c(0,100),
    breaks=seq(0,100,20),
    labels=function(x) paste0(x,"%"),
    expand=c(0,0)
  ) +
  labs(
    x="Correct to within (h)",
    y="% correct",
    colour=NULL,
    title="Absolute error CDF"
  ) +
  guides(
    colour=guide_legend(
      title="AUC, MedAE",
      title.position="top",
      ncol=1,
      byrow=TRUE,
      override.aes=list(
        linewidth=2.2,
        alpha=1
      )
    )
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size=14) +
  theme(
    text=element_text(
      family="Times New Roman",
      face="bold"
    ),
    plot.title=element_text(
      size=18,
      face="bold",
      hjust=0.5,
      margin=margin(b=10)
    ),
    axis.title.x=element_text(
      size=15,
      face="bold",
      margin=margin(t=8)
    ),
    axis.title.y=element_text(
      size=15,
      face="bold",
      margin=margin(r=8)
    ),
    axis.text.x=element_text(
      size=12,
      face="bold",
      colour="black"
    ),
    axis.text.y=element_text(
      size=12,
      face="bold",
      colour="black"
    ),
    axis.line=element_line(
      colour="#555555",
      linewidth=0.65
    ),
    axis.ticks=element_line(
      colour="#555555",
      linewidth=0.55
    ),
    legend.position=c(0.97,0.05),
    legend.justification=c(1,0),
    legend.direction="vertical",
    legend.background=element_rect(
      fill="white",
      colour="#555555",
      linewidth=0.45
    ),
    legend.title=element_text(
      size=10.5,
      face="bold",
      hjust=0.5
    ),
    legend.text=element_text(
      size=8.7,
      face="bold"
    ),
    legend.key=element_blank(),
    legend.key.width=grid::unit(0.65,"cm"),
    legend.key.height=grid::unit(0.32,"cm"),
    legend.spacing.y=grid::unit(0.01,"cm"),
    plot.margin=margin(8,10,8,8)
  )

print(p_fig2D)

ggsave(file.path(figure2_dir,"Figure2D_absolute_error_CDF_original_style.png"),p_fig2D,width=6.5,height=5.5,dpi=600,bg="white")
```

```{r}
figure2E_colors <- c(
  "Ground Truth"="#FBC600",
  "scRhythmBayes"="#A64078",
  "scRITMO"="#6E87B0",
  "Tempo"="#B2C1D6",
  "CoPhaser"="#D3CDDA",
  "CYCLOPS"="#C6D0DF",
  "reCAT"="#C7B5CC",
  "Cyclum"="#DBBACB",
  "scPrisma"="#B99BB5",
  "ZT-only"="#BFD8CC"
)
figure2E_density <- benchmark_long %>% filter(is.finite(abs_error_hour)) %>% mutate(Algorithm=factor(as.character(method),levels=figure2E_methods),err=abs_error_hour)

figure2E_metrics <- benchmark_summary %>% transmute(Algorithm=factor(as.character(method),levels=figure2E_methods),Coverage=Coverage,MAE=MAE,MedAE=MedAE,RMSE=RMSE,Within2h=Within2h,Within4h=Within4h)

time_to_rad <- function(x) 2*pi*((x%%24)/24)

get_circ_corr <- function(true_hour,pred_hour){ok <- is.finite(true_hour)&is.finite(pred_hour); theta <- circular::circular(time_to_rad(true_hour[ok]),units="radians",template="none",modulo="2pi"); phi <- circular::circular(time_to_rad(pred_hour[ok]),units="radians",template="none",modulo="2pi"); res <- circular::cor.circular(theta,phi,test=TRUE); data.frame(rho=unname(res[["cor"]]),p_value=unname(res[["p.value"]]),N=sum(ok))}

figure2E_rho <- bind_rows(lapply(figure2E_methods,function(m){x <- benchmark_long %>% filter(method==m); r <- get_circ_corr(x$T_true,x$pred_hour); r$Algorithm <- m; r})) %>% mutate(Algorithm=factor(Algorithm,levels=figure2E_methods),rho_label=sprintf("%.2f",rho))

figure2E_rmse <- figure2E_metrics %>% transmute(Algorithm=Algorithm,value=RMSE,label=sprintf("%.2f",RMSE))

figure2E_mae <- figure2E_metrics %>% transmute(Algorithm=Algorithm,value=MAE,label=sprintf("%.2f",MAE))

write.csv(figure2E_rho,file.path(figure2_dir,"Figure2E_circular_correlation_metrics.csv"),row.names=FALSE)
write.csv(figure2E_metrics,file.path(figure2_dir,"Figure2E_summary_metrics.csv"),row.names=FALSE)

print(figure2E_rho)
print(figure2E_metrics)
```

## CP1: simplified line benchmark
```{r}
cp1_method_order <- c("scRhythmBayes","ZT-only","scRITMO","Tempo","CoPhaser","CYCLOPS","reCAT","Cyclum","scPrisma")
cp1_method_labels <- c(
  "scRhythmBayes"="SRB","ZT-only"="ZT-only","scRITMO"="scRITMO",
  "Tempo"="Tempo","CoPhaser"="CoPhaser","CYCLOPS"="CYCLOPS",
  "reCAT"="reCAT","Cyclum"="Cyclum","scPrisma"="scPrisma"
)

cp1_colors <- c(
  "scRhythmBayes"="#4F8FC8",
  "ZT-only"="#B9B5B1",
  "scRITMO"="#B8D8C6",
  "Tempo"="#F2B3AC",
  "CoPhaser"="#F5CAA5",
  "CYCLOPS"="#D9AEB8",
  "reCAT"="#86C8C1",
  "Cyclum"="#C7B8DE",
  "scPrisma"="#DDBDD7"
)
cp1_A_data <- benchmark_by_celltype %>%
  mutate(
    method=factor(as.character(method),levels=cp1_method_order),
    sigma_bio_label=factor(
      as.character(sigma_bio_hour),
      levels=c("1.5","2.5","3.5","4.5","5.5","6.5")
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(method %in% cp1_method_order)

cp1_theme_simple <- theme_classic(base_size=9,base_family="Helvetica") +
  theme(
    axis.line=element_line(linewidth=0.35,colour="#30363B"),
    axis.ticks=element_line(linewidth=0.30,colour="#30363B"),
    axis.text=element_text(size=7.5,colour="#30363B"),
    axis.title=element_text(size=8.5,colour="#202428"),
    plot.title=element_text(size=10,face="bold",hjust=0.5,margin=margin(b=4)),
    legend.position="bottom",
    legend.title=element_blank(),
    legend.text=element_text(size=6.8),
    legend.key.width=grid::unit(0.42,"cm"),
    legend.key.height=grid::unit(0.28,"cm"),
    panel.grid=element_blank(),
    plot.margin=margin(5,6,4,5)
  )

p_cp1A_plotthis <- ggplot(cp1_A_data,aes(x=as.numeric(as.character(sigma_bio_label)),y=MAE,group=method,colour=method)) +
  geom_line(
    data=cp1_A_data %>% filter(!method %in% c("scRhythmBayes","ZT-only")),
    linewidth=0.55,
    alpha=0.78
  ) +
  geom_point(
    data=cp1_A_data %>% filter(!method %in% c("scRhythmBayes","ZT-only")),
    size=1.25,
    alpha=0.86
  ) +
  geom_line(
    data=cp1_A_data %>% filter(method=="ZT-only"),
    linewidth=0.72,
    linetype=2
  ) +
  geom_point(
    data=cp1_A_data %>% filter(method=="ZT-only"),
    shape=21,
    fill="white",
    size=1.65,
    stroke=0.48
  ) +
  geom_line(
    data=cp1_A_data %>% filter(method=="scRhythmBayes"),
    linewidth=1.15
  ) +
  geom_point(
    data=cp1_A_data %>% filter(method=="scRhythmBayes"),
    shape=21,
    fill="white",
    size=2.15,
    stroke=0.65
  ) +
  scale_colour_manual(values=cp1_colors,breaks=cp1_method_order,labels=cp1_method_labels,drop=FALSE) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks=c(1.5,2.5,3.5,4.5,5.5,6.5)) +
  labs(title="MAE",x="Biological dispersion (h)",y="Circular MAE (h)") +
  guides(colour="none") +
  cp1_theme_simple



```




## CP1-B: difference from ZT-only
```{r}
reference_red <- "#8B3A3A"

zt_baseline <- benchmark_by_celltype %>%
  filter(method=="ZT-only") %>%
  transmute(
    celltype=celltype,
    sigma_bio_hour=as.numeric(sigma_bio_hour),
    MAE_ZT=MAE
  )

cp1_B_order <- setdiff(cp1_method_order,"ZT-only")
cp1_B_colors <- cp1_colors[cp1_B_order]

cp1_B_data <- benchmark_by_celltype %>%
  filter(method!="ZT-only") %>%
  mutate(sigma_bio_hour=as.numeric(sigma_bio_hour)) %>%
  left_join(
    zt_baseline,
    by=c("celltype","sigma_bio_hour")
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    delta_MAE=MAE-MAE_ZT,
    method=factor(as.character(method),levels=cp1_B_order),
    sigma_bio_label=factor(
      as.character(sigma_bio_hour),
      levels=c("1.5","2.5","3.5","4.5","5.5","6.5")
    )
  )

p_cp1B_plotthis <- ggplot(cp1_B_data,aes(x=as.numeric(as.character(sigma_bio_label)),y=delta_MAE,group=method,colour=method)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept=0,colour="#626A70",linewidth=0.42,linetype=2) +
  geom_line(
    data=cp1_B_data %>% filter(method!="scRhythmBayes"),
    linewidth=0.55,
    alpha=0.78
  ) +
  geom_point(
    data=cp1_B_data %>% filter(method!="scRhythmBayes"),
    size=1.25,
    alpha=0.86
  ) +
  geom_line(
    data=cp1_B_data %>% filter(method=="scRhythmBayes"),
    linewidth=1.15
  ) +
  geom_point(
    data=cp1_B_data %>% filter(method=="scRhythmBayes"),
    shape=21,
    fill="white",
    size=2.15,
    stroke=0.65
  ) +
  scale_colour_manual(values=cp1_B_colors,breaks=cp1_B_order,drop=FALSE) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks=c(1.5,2.5,3.5,4.5,5.5,6.5)) +
  labs(title="MAE - ZT-only",x="Biological dispersion (h)",y="Difference (h)") +
  guides(colour=guide_legend(nrow=2,byrow=TRUE,override.aes=list(linewidth=0.8,alpha=1))) +
  cp1_theme_simple

p_cp1_simple_lines <- p_cp1A_plotthis+p_cp1B_plotthis+
  plot_layout(ncol=2,guides="collect") &
  theme(legend.position="bottom")

print(p_cp1_simple_lines)

ggsave(file.path(figure2_dir,"CP1_simple_line_benchmark.png"),p_cp1_simple_lines,width=7.2,height=3.7,dpi=600,bg="white")
ggsave(file.path(figure2_dir,"CP1_simple_line_benchmark.pdf"),p_cp1_simple_lines,width=7.2,height=3.7,device=grDevices::pdf,useDingbats=FALSE,bg="white")
ggsave(file.path(figure2_dir,"CP1_simple_line_benchmark.tiff"),p_cp1_simple_lines,width=7.2,height=3.7,dpi=600,compression="lzw",bg="white")

ggsave(file.path(figure2_dir,"CP1A_MAE_simple.png"),p_cp1A_plotthis,width=4.0,height=3.2,dpi=600,bg="white")
ggsave(file.path(figure2_dir,"CP1B_delta_MAE_simple.png"),p_cp1B_plotthis,width=4.0,height=3.2,dpi=600,bg="white")

```

```{r}
y_top <- yr[2]+0.08*yspan
```

## Figure 2E: global benchmark + numeric table
```{r}
## Figure 2E: global benchmark + numeric table

figure2E_benchmark_methods <- c("scRhythmBayes","ZT-only","scRITMO","Tempo","CoPhaser","CYCLOPS","reCAT","Cyclum","scPrisma")
figure2E_benchmark_labels <- c("scRhythmBayes"="SRB","ZT-only"="ZT-only","scRITMO"="scRITMO","Tempo"="Tempo","CoPhaser"="CoPhaser","CYCLOPS"="CYCLOPS","reCAT"="reCAT","Cyclum"="Cyclum","scPrisma"="scPrisma")
figure2E_benchmark_shapes <- c("CT1"=21,"CT2"=22,"CT3"=24,"CT4"=23,"CT5"=25,"CT6"=8)
figure2E_benchmark_colors <- figure_method_colors[figure2E_benchmark_methods]

figure2E_summary_long <- benchmark_summary %>% transmute(method=factor(as.character(method),levels=figure2E_benchmark_methods),MAE=MAE,MedAE=MedAE,RMSE=RMSE) %>% pivot_longer(c(MAE,MedAE,RMSE),names_to="metric",values_to="value") %>% mutate(metric=factor(metric,levels=c("MAE","MedAE","RMSE")))

figure2E_celltype_long <- benchmark_by_celltype %>% transmute(method=factor(as.character(method),levels=figure2E_benchmark_methods),celltype=factor(celltype,levels=paste0("CT",1:6)),MAE=MAE,MedAE=MedAE,RMSE=RMSE) %>% pivot_longer(c(MAE,MedAE,RMSE),names_to="metric",values_to="value") %>% mutate(metric=factor(metric,levels=c("MAE","MedAE","RMSE")))

figure2E_ceiling <- max(c(figure2E_summary_long$value,figure2E_celltype_long$value),na.rm=TRUE)
figure2E_ceiling <- ceiling(figure2E_ceiling*2)/2+0.35

plot_figure2E_metric <- function(metric_name,metric_title,show_y=FALSE){
  global_dat <- figure2E_summary_long %>% filter(metric==metric_name)
  ct_dat <- figure2E_celltype_long %>% filter(metric==metric_name)

  ggplot(mapping=aes(x=method,y=value)) +
    geom_col(data=global_dat %>% filter(method!="scRhythmBayes"),aes(fill=method),width=0.72,colour="#69737A",linewidth=0.35) +
    geom_col(data=global_dat %>% filter(method=="scRhythmBayes"),aes(fill=method),width=0.76,colour="#6F294F",linewidth=0.9) +
    geom_point(data=ct_dat,aes(shape=celltype),fill="white",colour="#3F4A52",size=2.6,stroke=0.68) +
    scale_fill_manual(name="Method",values=figure2E_benchmark_colors,breaks=figure2E_benchmark_methods,labels=figure2E_benchmark_labels,drop=FALSE) +
    scale_shape_manual(name="Cell type",values=figure2E_benchmark_shapes,breaks=paste0("CT",1:6),drop=FALSE) +
    scale_x_discrete(limits=figure2E_benchmark_methods,drop=FALSE) +
    scale_y_continuous(limits=c(0,figure2E_ceiling),breaks=seq(0,floor(figure2E_ceiling),2),expand=expansion(mult=c(0,0.015))) +
    labs(title=metric_title,x=NULL,y=if(show_y) "Circular error (h)" else NULL) +
    guides(fill=guide_legend(order=1,override.aes=list(colour=NA)),shape=guide_legend(order=2,override.aes=list(fill="white",colour="#3F4A52",size=3.2))) +
    theme_classic(base_size=12) +
    theme(text=element_text(family="Times New Roman"),plot.title=element_text(size=21,face="bold",hjust=0.5,margin=margin(b=8)),axis.title.y=element_text(size=17,face="bold",margin=margin(r=8)),axis.text.x=element_blank(),axis.ticks.x=element_blank(),axis.text.y=if(show_y) element_text(size=13,face="bold",colour="#303030") else element_blank(),axis.ticks.y=if(show_y) element_line(linewidth=0.45) else element_blank(),axis.line.y=if(show_y) element_line(linewidth=0.5) else element_blank(),axis.line.x=element_line(linewidth=0.45,colour="#303030"),legend.title=element_text(size=11.5,face="bold"),legend.text=element_text(size=10.5,face="bold"),legend.key.width=grid::unit(0.48,"cm"),legend.key.height=grid::unit(0.42,"cm"),plot.margin=margin(5,6,2,6))
}

make_figure2E_table <- function(metric_name){
  overall <- benchmark_summary %>% transmute(method=as.character(method),group="Overall",value=.data[[metric_name]])
  ct <- benchmark_by_celltype %>% transmute(method=as.character(method),group=as.character(celltype),value=.data[[metric_name]])
  tbl <- bind_rows(overall,ct) %>% filter(method %in% figure2E_benchmark_methods) %>% mutate(method=factor(method,levels=figure2E_benchmark_methods),group=factor(group,levels=c("Overall",paste0("CT",1:6))),row=length(figure2E_benchmark_methods)-match(as.character(method),figure2E_benchmark_methods)+1,x=ifelse(group=="Overall",1.15,match(as.character(group),paste0("CT",1:6))+1.15),label=sprintf("%.2f",value))
  method_df <- data.frame(method=figure2E_benchmark_methods,row=length(figure2E_benchmark_methods):1,label=unname(figure2E_benchmark_labels[figure2E_benchmark_methods]))
  header_df <- data.frame(x=c(0,1.15,2.15,3.15,4.15,5.15,6.15,7.15),label=c("Method","Overall",paste0("CT",1:6)))
  n <- length(figure2E_benchmark_methods)

  ggplot() +
    geom_text(data=tbl %>% filter(group!="Overall"),aes(x=x,y=row,label=label),family="Times New Roman",size=3.9,colour="#222222") +
    geom_text(data=tbl %>% filter(group=="Overall"),aes(x=x,y=row,label=label),family="Times New Roman",fontface="bold",size=4.0,colour="#222222") +
    geom_text(data=method_df,aes(x=0,y=row,label=label),family="Times New Roman",fontface="bold",size=3.85,colour="#222222",hjust=0.5) +
    geom_text(data=header_df,aes(x=x,y=n+0.78,label=label),family="Times New Roman",fontface="bold",size=4.0,colour="#222222") +
    annotate("segment",x=-0.50,xend=7.65,y=n+1.20,yend=n+1.20,linewidth=0.65,colour="#303030") +
    annotate("segment",x=-0.50,xend=7.65,y=n+0.34,yend=n+0.34,linewidth=0.50,colour="#303030") +
    annotate("segment",x=-0.50,xend=7.65,y=0.52,yend=0.52,linewidth=0.65,colour="#303030") +
    annotate("segment",x=0.58,xend=0.58,y=0.52,yend=n+1.20,linewidth=0.32,colour="#CCCCCC") +
    annotate("segment",x=1.68,xend=1.68,y=0.52,yend=n+1.20,linewidth=0.28,colour="#D7D7D7",linetype=2) +
    scale_x_continuous(limits=c(-0.55,7.70),expand=c(0,0)) +
    scale_y_continuous(limits=c(0.42,n+1.26),expand=c(0,0)) +
    coord_cartesian(clip="off") +
    theme_void() +
    theme(plot.margin=margin(0,5,1,5))
}

p_fig2E_mae <- plot_figure2E_metric("MAE","MAE",TRUE)
p_fig2E_medae <- plot_figure2E_metric("MedAE","Median AE")
p_fig2E_rmse <- plot_figure2E_metric("RMSE","RMSE")

t_fig2E_mae <- make_figure2E_table("MAE")
t_fig2E_medae <- make_figure2E_table("MedAE")
t_fig2E_rmse <- make_figure2E_table("RMSE")

p_fig2E_top <- (p_fig2E_mae+p_fig2E_medae+p_fig2E_rmse)+plot_layout(ncol=3,guides="collect")
p_fig2E_bottom <- (t_fig2E_mae+t_fig2E_medae+t_fig2E_rmse)+plot_layout(ncol=3)

p_fig2E_benchmark <- (p_fig2E_top/plot_spacer()/p_fig2E_bottom)+plot_layout(heights=c(1.18,0.035,0.76),guides="collect") & theme(legend.position="right",legend.direction="vertical",legend.box="vertical")

print(p_fig2E_benchmark)

ggsave(file.path(figure2_dir,"Figure2E_global_benchmark_final.png"),p_fig2E_benchmark,width=15,height=7.8,dpi=600,bg="white")
ggsave(file.path(figure2_dir,"Figure2E_global_benchmark_final.pdf"),p_fig2E_benchmark,width=15,height=7.8,device=cairo_pdf,bg="white")
```

#PLOT no ZT only
##Unified cell-phase benchmark
```{r}
suppressPackageStartupMessages({library(Matrix); library(dplyr); library(tidyr); library(ggplot2); library(plotthis)})

input_dir <- "outputs/simulation/output/scRITMO_extended_simulation/sigma_gradient_1p5_2p5_3p5_4p5_5p5_6p5_empirical_fixed_v1/R_input"
output_dir <- file.path(input_dir,"cell_phase_benchmark_SRB_ZT")
dir.create(output_dir,recursive=TRUE,showWarnings=FALSE)

metadata <- read.csv(file.path(input_dir,"metadata.csv"),stringsAsFactors=FALSE)
stopifnot(all(c("cell","sample_name","ZT","celltype","sigma_bio_hour","T_true","Theta_true") %in% names(metadata)),!anyDuplicated(metadata$cell),nrow(metadata)==9000)

wrap_hour <- function(x) (x+12)%%24-12
read_phase <- function(path,pred_col="pred_hour"){x <- read.csv(path,stringsAsFactors=FALSE); stopifnot("cell" %in% names(x),pred_col %in% names(x)); x <- x[match(metadata$cell,x$cell),,drop=FALSE]; stopifnot(identical(metadata$cell,x$cell)); x$pred_hour <- x[[pred_col]]; x}

method_order <- c("ZT-only","scRhythmBayes","scRITMO","Tempo","CoPhaser","CYCLOPS","reCAT","Cyclum","scPrisma")
method_colors <- c("scRhythmBayes"="#A8C7E6","scRITMO"="#BFD8CC","Tempo"="#F3B0AC","CoPhaser"="#F4C9A8","CYCLOPS"="#D9A3AE","reCAT"="#78B9B4","Cyclum"="#C7B7D8","scPrisma"="#D7B6D5")
truth_color <- "#FBC600"

ZT_only_cell_phase <- read_phase(file.path(output_dir,"ZT_only_cell_phase.csv"))
SRB_cell_phase <- read_phase(file.path(output_dir,"SRB_cell_phase.csv"))
scRITMO_cell_phase <- read_phase(file.path(input_dir,"cell_phase_benchmark_scRITMO","scRITMO_cell_phase.csv"))
Tempo_cell_phase <- read_phase(file.path(input_dir,"cell_phase_benchmark_Tempo","Tempo_cell_phase.csv"))
CoPhaser_cell_phase <- read_phase(file.path(input_dir,"cell_phase_benchmark_CoPhaser","CoPhaser_cell_phase.csv"))
CYCLOPS_cell_phase <- read_phase(file.path(input_dir,"cell_phase_benchmark_CYCLOPS","CYCLOPS_cell_phase.csv"))
reCAT_cell_phase <- read_phase(path.expand("outputs/cell_phase/reCAT_6CT/reCAT_6CT_cell_phase.csv"),"reCAT_phase_hour")
Cyclum_cell_phase <- read_phase(file.path(input_dir,"cell_phase_benchmark_Cyclum_by_CT","Cyclum_cell_phase.csv"))
scPrisma_cell_phase <- read_phase(file.path(input_dir,"cell_phase_benchmark_scPrisma_by_CT","scPrisma_cell_phase.csv"))

phase_results <- list(
  "ZT-only"=ZT_only_cell_phase,
  "scRhythmBayes"=SRB_cell_phase,
  "scRITMO"=scRITMO_cell_phase,
  "Tempo"=Tempo_cell_phase,
  "CoPhaser"=CoPhaser_cell_phase,
  "CYCLOPS"=CYCLOPS_cell_phase,
  "reCAT"=reCAT_cell_phase,
  "Cyclum"=Cyclum_cell_phase,
  "scPrisma"=scPrisma_cell_phase
)

benchmark_long <- bind_rows(lapply(names(phase_results),function(m) data.frame(cell=metadata$cell,celltype=metadata$celltype,sigma_bio_hour=metadata$sigma_bio_hour,ZT=metadata$ZT,T_true=metadata$T_true,method=m,pred_hour=phase_results[[m]]$pred_hour))) %>% mutate(method=factor(method,levels=method_order),celltype=factor(celltype,levels=paste0("CT",1:6)),wrapped_error_hour=wrap_hour(pred_hour-T_true),abs_error_hour=abs(wrapped_error_hour))

stopifnot(nrow(benchmark_long)==nrow(metadata)*length(method_order))
print(dim(benchmark_long))
print(table(benchmark_long$method,useNA="ifany"))

benchmark_summary <- benchmark_long %>% group_by(method) %>% summarise(N_total=n(),N_predicted=sum(is.finite(pred_hour)),Coverage=mean(is.finite(pred_hour)),MAE=mean(abs_error_hour,na.rm=TRUE),MedAE=median(abs_error_hour,na.rm=TRUE),RMSE=sqrt(mean(wrapped_error_hour^2,na.rm=TRUE)),Within2h=mean(abs_error_hour<=2,na.rm=TRUE),Within4h=mean(abs_error_hour<=4,na.rm=TRUE),.groups="drop") %>% arrange(MAE) %>% mutate(Rank_MAE=row_number())

benchmark_by_celltype <- benchmark_long %>% group_by(method,celltype,sigma_bio_hour) %>% summarise(N_total=n(),N_predicted=sum(is.finite(pred_hour)),Coverage=mean(is.finite(pred_hour)),MAE=mean(abs_error_hour,na.rm=TRUE),MedAE=median(abs_error_hour,na.rm=TRUE),RMSE=sqrt(mean(wrapped_error_hour^2,na.rm=TRUE)),Within2h=mean(abs_error_hour<=2,na.rm=TRUE),Within4h=mean(abs_error_hour<=4,na.rm=TRUE),.groups="drop")

benchmark_by_ZT <- benchmark_long %>% group_by(method,celltype,sigma_bio_hour,ZT) %>% summarise(N_total=n(),N_predicted=sum(is.finite(pred_hour)),Coverage=mean(is.finite(pred_hour)),MAE=mean(abs_error_hour,na.rm=TRUE),MedAE=median(abs_error_hour,na.rm=TRUE),RMSE=sqrt(mean(wrapped_error_hour^2,na.rm=TRUE)),Within2h=mean(abs_error_hour<=2,na.rm=TRUE),Within4h=mean(abs_error_hour<=4,na.rm=TRUE),.groups="drop")

write.csv(benchmark_long,file.path(output_dir,"benchmark_master_long_unified.csv"),row.names=FALSE)
write.csv(benchmark_summary,file.path(output_dir,"benchmark_summary_unified.csv"),row.names=FALSE)
write.csv(benchmark_by_celltype,file.path(output_dir,"benchmark_metrics_by_celltype.csv"),row.names=FALSE)
write.csv(benchmark_by_ZT,file.path(output_dir,"benchmark_metrics_by_celltype_ZT.csv"),row.names=FALSE)

print(benchmark_summary)
```

```{r}
)
```

## Figure 2B: circular cell-phase distribution
```{r}
## Figure 2B: circular cell-phase distribution
library(patchwork)
figure2B_methods <- figure_method_order
figure2B_method_colors <- figure_method_colors

figure2B_zt_colors <- c("ZT00"="#F08F8F","ZT04"="#F4BD7A","ZT08"="#D7D982","ZT12"="#8FC9A3","ZT16"="#79B9D5","ZT20"="#B19AD7")

figure2B_alg <- benchmark_long %>% filter(as.character(method)!="ZT-only") %>% transmute(cell=cell,celltype=celltype,ZT=ZT,Algorithm=as.character(method),Phase=pred_hour%%24)
figure2B_truth <- metadata %>% transmute(cell=cell,celltype=factor(celltype,levels=paste0("CT",1:6)),ZT=ZT,Algorithm="Ground Truth",Phase=T_true%%24)

figure2B_data <- bind_rows(figure2B_truth,figure2B_alg) %>% mutate(
  Algorithm=factor(Algorithm,levels=figure2B_methods),
  celltype=factor(celltype,levels=paste0("CT",1:6)),
  ZT_group=factor(sprintf("ZT%02d",ZT),levels=sprintf("ZT%02d",c(0,4,8,12,16,20))),
  ring=as.numeric(Algorithm)+5
) %>% droplevels()

figure2B_plot_data <- figure2B_data %>% filter(is.finite(Phase))

stopifnot(!anyNA(figure2B_data$Algorithm),!"ZT-only" %in% levels(figure2B_data$Algorithm))

ring_df <- data.frame(
  Algorithm=factor(figure2B_methods,levels=figure2B_methods),
  ring=seq_along(figure2B_methods)+5,
  method_color=unname(figure2B_method_colors[figure2B_methods])
)

figure2B_ring_limits <- c(5.4,max(ring_df$ring)+0.7)

plot_fig2B_CT <- function(ct,show_legend=TRUE){

  set.seed(20260917)

  dat_ct <- figure2B_plot_data %>% filter(celltype==ct) %>% group_by(Algorithm) %>% slice_sample(prop=1) %>% ungroup()

  ggplot(dat_ct,aes(x=Phase,y=ring)) +
    geom_hline(data=ring_df,aes(yintercept=ring,colour=method_color),inherit.aes=FALSE,linewidth=0.55,alpha=0.22) +
    geom_point(aes(fill=ZT_group),shape=21,size=2.2,stroke=0,alpha=0.48,position=position_jitter(width=0,height=0.08,seed=20260917)) +
    geom_text(data=ring_df,aes(x=0.60,y=ring,label=Algorithm),inherit.aes=FALSE,colour="#333333",size=4.2,fontface="bold",hjust=0) +
    scale_colour_identity() +
    scale_fill_manual(values=figure2B_zt_colors,drop=FALSE) +
    scale_x_continuous(limits=c(0,24),breaks=c(0,4,8,12,16,20),labels=paste0(c(0,4,8,12,16,20),"h"),expand=c(0,0)) +
    scale_y_continuous(limits=figure2B_ring_limits,breaks=NULL,expand=c(0,0)) +
    coord_polar(theta="x",start=0,direction=1,clip="off") +
    labs(fill="Sample ZT",title=ct) +
    guides(fill=guide_legend(ncol=1,byrow=TRUE,title.position="top",override.aes=list(shape=21,size=6,alpha=1,colour=NA))) +
    theme_minimal(base_size=16) +
    theme(
      text=element_text(family="Times New Roman"),
      plot.title=element_text(size=22,face="bold",hjust=0.5,margin=margin(b=5)),
      axis.title=element_blank(),
      axis.text.x=element_text(size=18,colour="#303030",face="bold"),
      axis.text.y=element_blank(),
      panel.grid.major.x=element_line(colour="#E5E5E5",linewidth=0.35),
      panel.grid.major.y=element_blank(),
      panel.grid.minor=element_blank(),
      legend.position=if(show_legend) "right" else "none",
      legend.direction="vertical",
      legend.box="vertical",
      legend.title=element_text(size=18.5,face="bold"),
      legend.text=element_text(size=18,face="bold"),
      legend.key.width=grid::unit(0.72,"cm"),
      legend.key.height=grid::unit(0.68,"cm"),
      legend.spacing.y=grid::unit(0.10,"cm"),
      plot.margin=margin(12,26,12,22)
    )
}

p_fig2B_all <- (
  plot_fig2B_CT("CT1",TRUE)+
  plot_fig2B_CT("CT2",TRUE)+
  plot_fig2B_CT("CT3",TRUE)+
  plot_fig2B_CT("CT4",TRUE)+
  plot_fig2B_CT("CT5",TRUE)+
  plot_fig2B_CT("CT6",TRUE)
) +
  plot_layout(ncol=3,guides="collect") +
  plot_annotation(
    title="Circular phase distribution",
    theme=theme(plot.title=element_text(family="Times New Roman",size=28,face="bold",hjust=0.5))
  ) &
  theme(legend.position="right",legend.direction="vertical",legend.box="vertical")

print(p_fig2B_all)

ggsave(file.path(figure2_dir,"Figure2B_circular_phase_distribution_no_ZTonly.png"),p_fig2B_all,width=20,height=13,dpi=600,bg="white")
ggsave(file.path(figure2_dir,"Figure2B_circular_phase_distribution_no_ZTonly.pdf"),p_fig2B_all,width=20,height=13,device=cairo_pdf,bg="white")

## Figure 2B overall: circular cell-phase distribution

  scale_y_continuous(limits=figure2B_ring_limits,breaks=NULL,expand=c(0,0)) +

    text=element_text(family="Times New Roman"),

ggsave(file.path(figure2_dir,"Figure2B_circular_phase_distribution_overall_no_ZTonly.png"),p_fig2B_overall,width=12,height=10,dpi=600,bg="white")
```

```{r}
  "scPrisma"="#B99BB5"
)
figure2C_data <- benchmark_long %>%
  filter(as.character(method)!="ZT-only",is.finite(pred_hour)) %>%
  mutate(
    method=factor(as.character(method),levels=figure2C_methods),
    pred_unwrapped=T_true+wrap_hour(pred_hour-T_true)
  ) %>%
  droplevels()

figure2C_ann <- benchmark_summary %>%
  filter(as.character(method)!="ZT-only") %>%
  mutate(
    method=factor(as.character(method),levels=figure2C_methods),
    label=ifelse(
      as.character(method)=="reCAT",
      sprintf("MAE = %.2f h\nCoverage = %.1f%%",MAE,100*Coverage),
      sprintf("MAE = %.2f h",MAE)
    )
  )

stopifnot(!anyNA(figure2C_data$method),!"ZT-only" %in% levels(figure2C_data$method))

) +

  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks=c(0,4,8,12,16,20,24),
    limits=c(0,24),
    expand=c(0,0)
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    breaks=seq(-8,32,4),
    limits=c(-10,34),
    expand=c(0,0)
  ) +
  labs(
    x="True cell phase (h)",
    y="Circularly unwrapped predicted phase (h)",
    title="Cell-phase recovery across benchmark methods"
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size=14) +
  theme(
    text=element_text(
      family="Times New Roman",
      face="bold"
    ),
```

## Figure 2D: Absolute-error CDF in original Figure-2 style
```{r}
figure2D_methods <- c("scRhythmBayes","scRITMO","Tempo","CoPhaser","CYCLOPS","reCAT","Cyclum","scPrisma")

figure2D_colors <- c("scRhythmBayes"="#A8C7E6","scRITMO"="#BFD8CC","Tempo"="#F3B0AC","CoPhaser"="#F4C9A8","CYCLOPS"="#D9A3AE","reCAT"="#78B9B4","Cyclum"="#C7B7D8","scPrisma"="#D7B6D5")
figure2D_colors <- c(
  "Ground Truth"="#FBC600",
  "scRhythmBayes"="#A64078",
  "scRITMO"="#6E87B0",
  "Tempo"="#B2C1D6",
  "CoPhaser"="#D3CDDA",
  "CYCLOPS"="#C6D0DF",
  "reCAT"="#C7B5CC",
  "Cyclum"="#DBBACB",
  "scPrisma"="#B99BB5"
)
figure2D_data <- benchmark_long %>% filter(as.character(method)!="ZT-only",is.finite(pred_hour),is.finite(abs_error_hour)) %>% mutate(method=factor(as.character(method),levels=figure2D_methods)) %>% droplevels()

stopifnot(!anyNA(figure2D_data$method),!"ZT-only" %in% levels(figure2D_data$method))

calculate_error_cdf <- function(df_method){err <- sort(df_method$abs_error_hour); xvals <- c(0,err,12); correct_pct <- vapply(xvals,function(x) 100*mean(err<=x),numeric(1)); x_norm <- xvals/12; y_norm <- correct_pct/100; auc <- sum(y_norm[-length(y_norm)]*diff(x_norm)); medae <- median(err); data.frame(x=xvals,correct_pct=correct_pct,AUC=auc,MedAE=medae)}

figure2D_cdf <- bind_rows(lapply(figure2D_methods,function(m){tmp <- figure2D_data %>% filter(method==m); out <- calculate_error_cdf(tmp); out$method <- m; out})) %>% mutate(method=factor(method,levels=figure2D_methods))

figure2D_metrics <- figure2D_cdf %>% group_by(method) %>% summarise(AUC=first(AUC),MedAE=first(MedAE),.groups="drop") %>% mutate(method=as.character(method)) %>% left_join(benchmark_summary %>% transmute(method=as.character(method),Coverage=Coverage),by="method") %>% mutate(method=factor(method,levels=figure2D_methods))

print(figure2D_metrics)

figure2D_metrics <- figure2D_metrics %>% mutate(label=ifelse(as.character(method)=="reCAT",sprintf("%s: %.3f, %.3f (%.1f%%)",method,AUC,MedAE,100*Coverage),sprintf("%s: %.3f, %.3f",method,AUC,MedAE)))

figure2D_labels <- setNames(figure2D_metrics$label,as.character(figure2D_metrics$method))

p_fig2D <- ggplot(
  figure2D_cdf,
  aes(
    x=x,
    y=correct_pct,
    colour=method,
    group=method
  )
) +
  geom_abline(
    intercept=0,
    slope=100/12,
    colour="#BDBDBD",
    linewidth=0.65,
    alpha=0.80
  ) +
  geom_step(
    linewidth=1.15,
    alpha=0.95
  ) +
  scale_colour_manual(
    values=figure2D_colors,
    breaks=figure2D_methods,
    labels=figure2D_labels,
    drop=FALSE
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    limits=c(0,12),
    breaks=seq(0,12,2),
    expand=c(0,0)
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    limits=c(0,100),
    breaks=seq(0,100,20),
    labels=function(x) paste0(x,"%"),
    expand=c(0,0)
  ) +
  labs(
    x="Correct to within (h)",
    y="% correct",
    colour=NULL,
    title="Absolute error CDF"
  ) +
  guides(
    colour=guide_legend(
      title="AUC, MedAE",
      title.position="top",
      ncol=1,
      byrow=TRUE,
      override.aes=list(
        linewidth=2.2,
        alpha=1
      )
    )
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size=14) +
  theme(
    text=element_text(
      family="Times New Roman",
      face="bold"
    ),
    plot.title=element_text(
      size=18,
      face="bold",
      hjust=0.5,
      margin=margin(b=10)
    ),
    axis.title.x=element_text(
      size=15,
      face="bold",
      margin=margin(t=8)
    ),
    axis.title.y=element_text(
      size=15,
      face="bold",
      margin=margin(r=8)
    ),
    axis.text.x=element_text(
      size=12,
      face="bold",
      colour="black"
    ),
    axis.text.y=element_text(
      size=12,
      face="bold",
      colour="black"
    ),
    axis.line=element_line(
      colour="#555555",
      linewidth=0.65
    ),
    axis.ticks=element_line(
      colour="#555555",
      linewidth=0.55
    ),
    legend.position=c(0.97,0.05),
    legend.justification=c(1,0),
    legend.direction="vertical",
    legend.background=element_rect(
      fill="white",
      colour="#555555",
      linewidth=0.45
    ),
    legend.title=element_text(
      size=10.5,
      face="bold",
      hjust=0.5
    ),
    legend.text=element_text(
      size=8.7,
      face="bold"
    ),
    legend.key=element_blank(),
    legend.key.width=grid::unit(0.65,"cm"),
    legend.key.height=grid::unit(0.32,"cm"),
    legend.spacing.y=grid::unit(0.01,"cm"),
    plot.margin=margin(8,10,8,8)
  )

print(p_fig2D)

ggsave(file.path(figure2_dir,"Figure2D_absolute_error_CDF_original_style_no_ZTonly.png"),p_fig2D,width=6.5,height=5.5,dpi=600,bg="white")
ggsave(file.path(figure2_dir,"Figure2D_absolute_error_CDF_original_style_no_ZTonly.pdf"),p_fig2D,width=6.5,height=5.5,device=cairo_pdf,bg="white")
write.csv(figure2D_metrics,file.path(figure2_dir,"Figure2D_absolute_error_CDF_metrics_no_ZTonly.csv"),row.names=FALSE)
```

## Figure 2E: summary metrics
```{r}
## Figure 2E: summary metrics

suppressPackageStartupMessages({library(dplyr); library(tidyr); library(ggplot2); library(plotthis); library(circular); library(patchwork)})

figure2E_methods <- c("scRhythmBayes","scRITMO","Tempo","CoPhaser","CYCLOPS","reCAT","Cyclum","scPrisma")

figure2E_colors <- c("scRhythmBayes"="#A8C7E6","scRITMO"="#BFD8CC","Tempo"="#F3B0AC","CoPhaser"="#F4C9A8","CYCLOPS"="#D9A3AE","reCAT"="#78B9B4","Cyclum"="#C7B7D8","scPrisma"="#D7B6D5")
figure2E_colors <- c(
  "Ground Truth"="#FBC600",
  "scRhythmBayes"="#A64078",
  "scRITMO"="#6E87B0",
  "Tempo"="#B2C1D6",
  "CoPhaser"="#D3CDDA",
  "CYCLOPS"="#C6D0DF",
  "reCAT"="#C7B5CC",
  "Cyclum"="#DBBACB",
  "scPrisma"="#B99BB5"
)
figure2E_density <- benchmark_long %>% filter(as.character(method)!="ZT-only",is.finite(abs_error_hour)) %>% mutate(Algorithm=factor(as.character(method),levels=figure2E_methods),err=abs_error_hour) %>% droplevels()

figure2E_metrics <- benchmark_summary %>% filter(as.character(method)!="ZT-only") %>% transmute(Algorithm=factor(as.character(method),levels=figure2E_methods),Coverage=Coverage,MAE=MAE,MedAE=MedAE,RMSE=RMSE,Within2h=Within2h,Within4h=Within4h) %>% droplevels()

stopifnot(!anyNA(figure2E_density$Algorithm),!"ZT-only" %in% levels(figure2E_density$Algorithm))

time_to_rad <- function(x) 2*pi*((x%%24)/24)

get_circ_corr <- function(true_hour,pred_hour){ok <- is.finite(true_hour)&is.finite(pred_hour); theta <- circular::circular(time_to_rad(true_hour[ok]),units="radians",template="none",modulo="2pi"); phi <- circular::circular(time_to_rad(pred_hour[ok]),units="radians",template="none",modulo="2pi"); res <- circular::cor.circular(theta,phi,test=TRUE); data.frame(rho=unname(res[["cor"]]),p_value=unname(res[["p.value"]]),N=sum(ok))}

figure2E_rho <- bind_rows(lapply(figure2E_methods,function(m){x <- benchmark_long %>% filter(method==m); r <- get_circ_corr(x$T_true,x$pred_hour); r$Algorithm <- m; r})) %>% mutate(Algorithm=factor(Algorithm,levels=figure2E_methods),rho_label=sprintf("%.2f",rho))

figure2E_rmse <- figure2E_metrics %>% transmute(Algorithm=Algorithm,value=RMSE,label=sprintf("%.2f",RMSE))

figure2E_mae <- figure2E_metrics %>% transmute(Algorithm=Algorithm,value=MAE,label=sprintf("%.2f",MAE))

write.csv(figure2E_rho,file.path(figure2_dir,"Figure2E_circular_correlation_metrics_no_ZTonly.csv"),row.names=FALSE)
write.csv(figure2E_metrics,file.path(figure2_dir,"Figure2E_summary_metrics_no_ZTonly.csv"),row.names=FALSE)

print(figure2E_metrics)
```

```{r}
  labs(title="MAE",x="Biological dispersion (h)",y="Circular MAE (h)") +
  guides(colour="none") +
  cp1_theme_simple
```

```{r}
srb_baseline <- benchmark_by_celltype %>%
  filter(as.character(method)=="scRhythmBayes") %>%

    celltype=celltype,

      as.character(sigma_bio_hour),

stopifnot(

  all(is.finite(cp1_B_data$delta_MAE_vs_scRhythmBayes))
)

p_cp1B_plotthis <- ggplot(cp1_B_data,aes(x=as.numeric(as.character(sigma_bio_label)),y=delta_MAE_vs_scRhythmBayes,group=method,colour=method)) +
```

## Figure 2E: global benchmark + numeric table
```{r}
## Figure 2E: global benchmark + numeric table

figure2E_benchmark_methods <- c("scRhythmBayes","scRITMO","Tempo","CoPhaser","CYCLOPS","reCAT","Cyclum","scPrisma")
figure2E_benchmark_labels <- c("scRhythmBayes"="SRB","scRITMO"="scRITMO","Tempo"="Tempo","CoPhaser"="CoPhaser","CYCLOPS"="CYCLOPS","reCAT"="reCAT","Cyclum"="Cyclum","scPrisma"="scPrisma")
figure2E_benchmark_shapes <- c("CT1"=21,"CT2"=22,"CT3"=24,"CT4"=23,"CT5"=25,"CT6"=8)
figure2E_benchmark_colors <- figure_method_colors[figure2E_benchmark_methods]

figure2E_summary_long <- benchmark_summary %>% filter(as.character(method)!="ZT-only") %>% transmute(method=factor(as.character(method),levels=figure2E_benchmark_methods),MAE=MAE,MedAE=MedAE,RMSE=RMSE) %>% pivot_longer(c(MAE,MedAE,RMSE),names_to="metric",values_to="value") %>% mutate(metric=factor(metric,levels=c("MAE","MedAE","RMSE"))) %>% droplevels()

figure2E_celltype_long <- benchmark_by_celltype %>% filter(as.character(method)!="ZT-only") %>% transmute(method=factor(as.character(method),levels=figure2E_benchmark_methods),celltype=factor(celltype,levels=paste0("CT",1:6)),MAE=MAE,MedAE=MedAE,RMSE=RMSE) %>% pivot_longer(c(MAE,MedAE,RMSE),names_to="metric",values_to="value") %>% mutate(metric=factor(metric,levels=c("MAE","MedAE","RMSE"))) %>% droplevels()

stopifnot(!anyNA(figure2E_summary_long$method),!"ZT-only" %in% levels(figure2E_summary_long$method))

figure2E_ceiling <- max(c(figure2E_summary_long$value,figure2E_celltype_long$value),na.rm=TRUE)
figure2E_ceiling <- ceiling(figure2E_ceiling*2)/2+0.35

plot_figure2E_metric <- function(metric_name,metric_title,show_y=FALSE){
  global_dat <- figure2E_summary_long %>% filter(metric==metric_name)
  ct_dat <- figure2E_celltype_long %>% filter(metric==metric_name)

  ggplot(mapping=aes(x=method,y=value)) +
    geom_col(data=global_dat %>% filter(method!="scRhythmBayes"),aes(fill=method),width=0.72,colour="#69737A",linewidth=0.35) +
    geom_col(data=global_dat %>% filter(method=="scRhythmBayes"),aes(fill=method),width=0.76,colour="#6F294F",linewidth=0.9) +
    geom_point(data=ct_dat,aes(shape=celltype),fill="white",colour="#3F4A52",size=2.6,stroke=0.68) +
    scale_fill_manual(name="Method",values=figure2E_benchmark_colors,breaks=figure2E_benchmark_methods,labels=figure2E_benchmark_labels,drop=FALSE) +
    scale_shape_manual(name="Cell type",values=figure2E_benchmark_shapes,breaks=paste0("CT",1:6),drop=FALSE) +
    scale_x_discrete(limits=figure2E_benchmark_methods,drop=FALSE) +
    scale_y_continuous(limits=c(0,figure2E_ceiling),breaks=seq(0,floor(figure2E_ceiling),2),expand=expansion(mult=c(0,0.015))) +
    labs(title=metric_title,x=NULL,y=if(show_y) "Circular error (h)" else NULL) +
    guides(fill=guide_legend(order=1,override.aes=list(colour=NA)),shape=guide_legend(order=2,override.aes=list(fill="white",colour="#3F4A52",size=3.2))) +
    theme_classic(base_size=12) +
    theme(text=element_text(family="Times New Roman"),plot.title=element_text(size=21,face="bold",hjust=0.5,margin=margin(b=8)),axis.title.y=element_text(size=17,face="bold",margin=margin(r=8)),axis.text.x=element_blank(),axis.ticks.x=element_blank(),axis.text.y=if(show_y) element_text(size=13,face="bold",colour="#303030") else element_blank(),axis.ticks.y=if(show_y) element_line(linewidth=0.45) else element_blank(),axis.line.y=if(show_y) element_line(linewidth=0.5) else element_blank(),axis.line.x=element_line(linewidth=0.45,colour="#303030"),legend.title=element_text(size=11.5,face="bold"),legend.text=element_text(size=10.5,face="bold"),legend.key.width=grid::unit(0.48,"cm"),legend.key.height=grid::unit(0.42,"cm"),plot.margin=margin(5,6,2,6))
}

make_figure2E_table <- function(metric_name){
  overall <- benchmark_summary %>% filter(as.character(method)!="ZT-only") %>% transmute(method=as.character(method),group="Overall",value=.data[[metric_name]])
  ct <- benchmark_by_celltype %>% filter(as.character(method)!="ZT-only") %>% transmute(method=as.character(method),group=as.character(celltype),value=.data[[metric_name]])
  tbl <- bind_rows(overall,ct) %>% filter(method %in% figure2E_benchmark_methods) %>% mutate(method=factor(method,levels=figure2E_benchmark_methods),group=factor(group,levels=c("Overall",paste0("CT",1:6))),row=length(figure2E_benchmark_methods)-match(as.character(method),figure2E_benchmark_methods)+1,x=ifelse(group=="Overall",1.15,match(as.character(group),paste0("CT",1:6))+1.15),label=sprintf("%.2f",value))
  method_df <- data.frame(method=figure2E_benchmark_methods,row=length(figure2E_benchmark_methods):1,label=unname(figure2E_benchmark_labels[figure2E_benchmark_methods]))
  header_df <- data.frame(x=c(0,1.15,2.15,3.15,4.15,5.15,6.15,7.15),label=c("Method","Overall",paste0("CT",1:6)))
  n <- length(figure2E_benchmark_methods)

  ggplot() +
    geom_text(data=tbl %>% filter(group!="Overall"),aes(x=x,y=row,label=label),family="Times New Roman",size=3.9,colour="#222222") +
    geom_text(data=tbl %>% filter(group=="Overall"),aes(x=x,y=row,label=label),family="Times New Roman",fontface="bold",size=4.0,colour="#222222") +
    geom_text(data=method_df,aes(x=0,y=row,label=label),family="Times New Roman",fontface="bold",size=3.85,colour="#222222",hjust=0.5) +
    geom_text(data=header_df,aes(x=x,y=n+0.78,label=label),family="Times New Roman",fontface="bold",size=4.0,colour="#222222") +
    annotate("segment",x=-0.50,xend=7.65,y=n+1.20,yend=n+1.20,linewidth=0.65,colour="#303030") +
    annotate("segment",x=-0.50,xend=7.65,y=n+0.34,yend=n+0.34,linewidth=0.50,colour="#303030") +
    annotate("segment",x=-0.50,xend=7.65,y=0.52,yend=0.52,linewidth=0.65,colour="#303030") +
    annotate("segment",x=0.58,xend=0.58,y=0.52,yend=n+1.20,linewidth=0.32,colour="#CCCCCC") +
    annotate("segment",x=1.68,xend=1.68,y=0.52,yend=n+1.20,linewidth=0.28,colour="#D7D7D7",linetype=2) +
    scale_x_continuous(limits=c(-0.55,7.70),expand=c(0,0)) +
    scale_y_continuous(limits=c(0.42,n+1.26),expand=c(0,0)) +
    coord_cartesian(clip="off") +
    theme_void() +
    theme(plot.margin=margin(0,5,1,5))
}

p_fig2E_mae <- plot_figure2E_metric("MAE","MAE",TRUE)
p_fig2E_medae <- plot_figure2E_metric("MedAE","Median AE")
p_fig2E_rmse <- plot_figure2E_metric("RMSE","RMSE")

t_fig2E_mae <- make_figure2E_table("MAE")
t_fig2E_medae <- make_figure2E_table("MedAE")
t_fig2E_rmse <- make_figure2E_table("RMSE")

p_fig2E_top <- (p_fig2E_mae+p_fig2E_medae+p_fig2E_rmse)+plot_layout(ncol=3,guides="collect")
p_fig2E_bottom <- (t_fig2E_mae+t_fig2E_medae+t_fig2E_rmse)+plot_layout(ncol=3)

p_fig2E_benchmark <- (p_fig2E_top/plot_spacer()/p_fig2E_bottom)+plot_layout(heights=c(1.18,0.035,0.76),guides="collect") & theme(legend.position="right",legend.direction="vertical",legend.box="vertical")

print(p_fig2E_benchmark)

ggsave(file.path(figure2_dir,"Figure2E_global_benchmark_final_no_ZTonly.png"),p_fig2E_benchmark,width=15,height=7.8,dpi=600,bg="white")
ggsave(file.path(figure2_dir,"Figure2E_global_benchmark_final_no_ZTonly.pdf"),p_fig2E_benchmark,width=15,height=7.8,device=cairo_pdf,bg="white")
```

```{r}
  "scRITMO","Salati et al.","Circadian","Probabilistic","No","Native model","Model output","Phase",
  "Tempo","Auerbach et al.","Circadian","Bayesian VI","No","Gene acrophase","Reference gene","Phase",
  "reCAT","Liu et al.","Cyclic","TSP/HMM","No","15 circadian genes","ZT","Order",
  "CoPhaser","Paychère et al.","Cyclic","VAE","No","Gene phase/amp","ZT","Phase",
  "Cyclum","Liang et al.","Cyclic","Autoencoder","No","Data-driven","ZT","Pseudotime",
  "CYCLOPS","Anafi et al.","Circadian","Autoencoder","No","Rhythmic features","ZT","Phase"
)

figure2F_rank_score <- function(x){
  r <- rank(x,ties.method="average",na.last="keep")
  n <- sum(is.finite(x))
  if(n<=1) return(rep(1,length(x)))
  1-(r-1)/(n-1)
}

figure2F_overall <- benchmark_summary %>%
  mutate(method=as.character(method)) %>%
  filter(method!="ZT-only") %>%
  transmute(method,coverage=Coverage,overall=MAE)

figure2F_by_ct <- benchmark_by_celltype %>%
  mutate(method=as.character(method),celltype=as.character(celltype)) %>%
  filter(method!="ZT-only") %>%
  dplyr::select(method,celltype,MAE) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from=celltype,values_from=MAE)

figure2F_data <- figure2F_overall %>%
  left_join(figure2F_by_ct,by="method") %>%
  left_join(figure2F_method_info,by="method") %>%
  arrange(overall,method) %>%
  mutate(mae_rank=row_number(),id=as.character(mae_rank)) %>%
  mutate(across(all_of(figure2F_metric_cols),figure2F_rank_score,.names="score_{.col}")) %>%
  mutate(
    coverage_label=sprintf("%.0f%%",100*coverage),
    across(all_of(figure2F_metric_cols),~sprintf("%.2f",.x),.names="{.col}_label")
  )
```

# Cell-to-Gene phase uncertainty sensitivity analysis

## 1. Read and verify Cell-to-Gene inputs
```{r phase-sensitivity-input}
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(Matrix)
  library(dplyr)
  library(tidyr)
  library(tibble)
  library(ggplot2)
})

sensitivity_simulation_dir <- dirname(input_dir)
sensitivity_output_dir <- file.path(input_dir, "cell_to_gene_phase_sensitivity")
dir.create(sensitivity_output_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

source("../R/infer_cell_phase.R")
source("../R/infer_gene_param.R")

sensitivity_count <- as(readMM(file.path(input_dir, "count_gene_by_cell.mtx")), "CsparseMatrix")
sensitivity_genes <- read.csv(file.path(input_dir, "genes.csv"), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
sensitivity_metadata <- read.csv(file.path(input_dir, "metadata.csv"), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
sensitivity_cell_truth <- read.csv(file.path(sensitivity_simulation_dir, "cell_truth.csv"), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
sensitivity_gene_truth <- read.csv(file.path(sensitivity_simulation_dir, "gene_truth.csv"), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

rownames(sensitivity_count) <- sensitivity_genes$gene
colnames(sensitivity_count) <- sensitivity_metadata$cell
rownames(sensitivity_metadata) <- sensitivity_metadata$cell

sensitivity_metadata <- sensitivity_metadata[match(colnames(sensitivity_count), sensitivity_metadata$cell), , drop = FALSE]
sensitivity_cell_truth <- sensitivity_cell_truth[match(sensitivity_metadata$cell, sensitivity_cell_truth$cell_id), , drop = FALSE]
sensitivity_gene_truth <- sensitivity_gene_truth %>%
  mutate(
    gene_id = as.character(gene_id),
    celltype = as.character(celltype),
    is_seed = tolower(as.character(is_seed)) == "true",
    true_rhythmic = tolower(as.character(true_rhythmic)) == "true"
  )

stopifnot(nrow(sensitivity_count) == nrow(sensitivity_genes))
stopifnot(ncol(sensitivity_count) == nrow(sensitivity_metadata))
stopifnot(identical(colnames(sensitivity_count), sensitivity_metadata$cell))
stopifnot(identical(sensitivity_metadata$cell, sensitivity_cell_truth$cell_id))
stopifnot(max(abs(sensitivity_metadata$Theta_true - sensitivity_cell_truth$true_phase_rad)) < 1e-12)
stopifnot(max(abs(sensitivity_metadata$T_true - sensitivity_cell_truth$true_phase_hour)) < 1e-12)
stopifnot(setequal(rownames(sensitivity_count), unique(sensitivity_gene_truth$gene_id)))
stopifnot(all(table(sensitivity_metadata$sample_name) > 0))
stopifnot(all(table(sensitivity_metadata$sample_name, sensitivity_metadata$celltype) > 0))

sensitivity_truth_check <- sensitivity_gene_truth %>%
  group_by(gene_id) %>%
  summarise(
    n_mesor = n_distinct(true_mesor),
    n_amplitude = n_distinct(true_amplitude),
    n_phase = n_distinct(true_phase_rad),
    n_rhythmic = n_distinct(true_rhythmic),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

stopifnot(all(sensitivity_truth_check$n_mesor == 1))
stopifnot(all(sensitivity_truth_check$n_amplitude == 1))
stopifnot(all(sensitivity_truth_check$n_phase == 1))
stopifnot(all(sensitivity_truth_check$n_rhythmic == 1))

sensitivity_input_summary <- data.frame(
  n_cells = ncol(sensitivity_count),
  n_genes = nrow(sensitivity_count),
  n_celltypes = n_distinct(sensitivity_metadata$celltype),
  n_samples = n_distinct(sensitivity_metadata$sample_name),
  n_non_seed_genes = sum(!sensitivity_gene_truth$is_seed) / n_distinct(sensitivity_gene_truth$celltype),
  n_non_seed_rhythmic = sum(!sensitivity_gene_truth$is_seed & sensitivity_gene_truth$true_rhythmic) / n_distinct(sensitivity_gene_truth$celltype),
  n_non_seed_null = sum(!sensitivity_gene_truth$is_seed & !sensitivity_gene_truth$true_rhythmic) / n_distinct(sensitivity_gene_truth$celltype)
)

write.csv(sensitivity_input_summary, file.path(sensitivity_output_dir, "input_summary.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
sensitivity_input_summary
```

## 2. Reproduce current SRB phase with the latest Cell-level function
```{r phase-sensitivity-cell-phase, message=TRUE}
sensitivity_phase <- infer_cell_phase(
  count = sensitivity_count,
  metadata = sensitivity_metadata,
  ZT_by = "ZT",
  strata_by = "celltype",
  Species = "mouse",
  min_seed = 0.01,
  family = "NB",
  setseed = 1,
  Verbose = TRUE
)

sensitivity_phase <- sensitivity_phase[match(sensitivity_metadata$cell, sensitivity_phase$cell), , drop = FALSE]
sensitivity_saved_phase <- read.csv(
  file.path(input_dir, "cell_phase_benchmark_SRB_ZT", "SRB_cell_phase.csv"),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)
sensitivity_saved_phase <- sensitivity_saved_phase[match(sensitivity_metadata$cell, sensitivity_saved_phase$cell), , drop = FALSE]

stopifnot(identical(as.character(sensitivity_phase$cell), sensitivity_metadata$cell))
stopifnot(identical(as.character(sensitivity_saved_phase$cell), sensitivity_metadata$cell))

sensitivity_phase_alignment <- data.frame(
  cell = sensitivity_metadata$cell,
  phase_difference_rad = atan2(
    sin(sensitivity_phase$theta_pred - sensitivity_saved_phase$pred_rad),
    cos(sensitivity_phase$theta_pred - sensitivity_saved_phase$pred_rad)
  ),
  r_cell_difference = sensitivity_phase$r_cell - sensitivity_saved_phase$r_cell
)

stopifnot(max(abs(sensitivity_phase_alignment$phase_difference_rad)) < 1e-10)
stopifnot(max(abs(sensitivity_phase_alignment$r_cell_difference)) < 1e-10)

write.csv(sensitivity_phase_alignment, file.path(sensitivity_output_dir, "current_vs_saved_SRB_phase.csv"), row.names = FALSE)

sensitivity_method_order <- c(
  "Oracle true phase",
  "Predicted phase + uniform weight",
  "Current SRB phase + r_cell",
  "ZT-only + uniform weight"
)

sensitivity_phase_input <- bind_rows(
  data.frame(cell = sensitivity_metadata$cell, Method = sensitivity_method_order[1], theta_pred = sensitivity_metadata$Theta_true, r_cell = 1),
  data.frame(cell = sensitivity_metadata$cell, Method = sensitivity_method_order[2], theta_pred = sensitivity_phase$theta_pred, r_cell = 1),
  data.frame(cell = sensitivity_metadata$cell, Method = sensitivity_method_order[3], theta_pred = sensitivity_phase$theta_pred, r_cell = sensitivity_phase$r_cell),
  data.frame(cell = sensitivity_metadata$cell, Method = sensitivity_method_order[4], theta_pred = sensitivity_metadata$ZT * 2*pi/24, r_cell = 1)
)

write.csv(sensitivity_phase_input, file.path(sensitivity_output_dir, "phase_inputs_by_cell.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
```



## 3. Fit the same sample-aware Gene-level model
```{r phase-sensitivity-gene-fit, message=TRUE}

sensitivity_predicted_fit <- infer_gene_param(

)

sensitivity_current_fit <- infer_gene_param(
  count = sensitivity_count,

)

sensitivity_ZT_fit <- infer_gene_param(

sensitivity_fit <- list(
  "Oracle true phase" = sensitivity_oracle_fit,
  "Predicted phase + uniform weight" = sensitivity_predicted_fit,
```
