```{r phase-sensitivity-gene-fit, message=TRUE}
  "ZT-only + uniform weight" = sensitivity_ZT_fit
)

saveRDS(sensitivity_fit, file.path(sensitivity_output_dir, "gene_level_phase_sensitivity_fits.rds"))
```

## 4. Non-seed rhythmicity and parameter recovery
```{r phase-sensitivity-metrics}
sensitivity_collect_result <- function(fit, method) {
  fit$param_long %>%
    left_join(
      fit$gene_eligibility %>% select(gene, celltype, eligible),
      by = c("gene", "celltype")
    ) %>%
    mutate(Method = method)
}

sensitivity_estimate <- bind_rows(
  sensitivity_collect_result(sensitivity_oracle_fit, sensitivity_method_order[1]),
  sensitivity_collect_result(sensitivity_predicted_fit, sensitivity_method_order[2]),
  sensitivity_collect_result(sensitivity_current_fit, sensitivity_method_order[3]),
  sensitivity_collect_result(sensitivity_ZT_fit, sensitivity_method_order[4])
)

sensitivity_truth <- sensitivity_gene_truth %>%
  filter(!is_seed) %>%
  transmute(
    gene = gene_id,
    celltype,
    true_mesor,
    true_amplitude,
    true_phase_rad,
    true_rhythmic
  )

sensitivity_evaluation <- sensitivity_truth %>%
  tidyr::crossing(Method = sensitivity_method_order) %>%
  left_join(
    sensitivity_estimate,
    by = c("gene", "celltype", "Method")
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    sensitivity_metadata %>% distinct(celltype, sigma_bio_hour),
    by = "celltype"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    eligible = dplyr::coalesce(eligible, FALSE),
    Tested = is.finite(P_value) & is.finite(FDR),
    P_positive = is.finite(P_value) & P_value < 0.05,
    Detected = is.finite(FDR) & FDR < 0.05,
    Mesor_absolute_error_raw = abs(Mesor - true_mesor),
    Amplitude_absolute_error = abs(Amplitude - true_amplitude),
    Amplitude_shrunk_absolute_error = abs(Amplitude_shrunk - true_amplitude),
    Acrophase_error_hour = ifelse(
      true_rhythmic & is.finite(Phase),
      abs(atan2(sin(Phase - true_phase_rad), cos(Phase - true_phase_rad))) * 24/(2*pi),
      NA_real_
    )
  ) %>%
  group_by(Method, celltype) %>%
  mutate(
    Mesor_offset = median(Mesor - true_mesor, na.rm = TRUE),
    Mesor_absolute_error_centered = abs(Mesor - Mesor_offset - true_mesor)
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(Method = factor(Method, levels = sensitivity_method_order))

sensitivity_summary <- sensitivity_evaluation %>%
  group_by(Method, celltype, sigma_bio_hour) %>%
  summarise(
    N_non_seed = n(),
    N_truth_rhythmic = sum(true_rhythmic),
    N_truth_null = sum(!true_rhythmic),
    N_eligible = sum(eligible),
    N_tested = sum(Tested),
    N_detected = sum(Detected),
    True_positive = sum(Detected & true_rhythmic),
    False_positive = sum(Detected & !true_rhythmic),
    Power = True_positive / N_truth_rhythmic,
    Power_tested = True_positive / pmax(sum(Tested & true_rhythmic), 1),
    Type_I_error = sum(P_positive & !true_rhythmic) / pmax(sum(Tested & !true_rhythmic), 1),
    Realized_FDP = False_positive / pmax(N_detected, 1),
    Detection_rate = N_detected / N_non_seed,
    Mesor_offset = first(Mesor_offset),
    Mesor_MAE_raw = mean(Mesor_absolute_error_raw, na.rm = TRUE),
    Mesor_MAE_centered = mean(Mesor_absolute_error_centered, na.rm = TRUE),
    Amplitude_MAE = mean(Amplitude_absolute_error, na.rm = TRUE),
    Amplitude_shrunk_MAE = mean(Amplitude_shrunk_absolute_error, na.rm = TRUE),
    Acrophase_MAE_hour = mean(Acrophase_error_hour, na.rm = TRUE),
    N_acrophase = sum(is.finite(Acrophase_error_hour)),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

write.csv(sensitivity_evaluation, file.path(sensitivity_output_dir, "gene_level_phase_sensitivity_long.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(sensitivity_summary, file.path(sensitivity_output_dir, "gene_level_phase_sensitivity_summary.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
sensitivity_summary
```



## 5. Paired changes relative to Oracle phase
```{r phase-sensitivity-paired}
sensitivity_oracle_gene <- sensitivity_evaluation %>%
  filter(Method == sensitivity_method_order[1]) %>%
  select(
    gene,
    celltype,
    Oracle_Detected = Detected,
    Oracle_P_positive = P_positive,
    Oracle_Mesor_absolute_error_centered = Mesor_absolute_error_centered,
    Oracle_Amplitude_shrunk_absolute_error = Amplitude_shrunk_absolute_error,
    Oracle_Acrophase_error_hour = Acrophase_error_hour
  )

sensitivity_paired <- sensitivity_evaluation %>%
  filter(Method != sensitivity_method_order[1]) %>%
  inner_join(sensitivity_oracle_gene, by = c("gene", "celltype")) %>%
  mutate(
    Delta_detected = as.integer(Detected) - as.integer(Oracle_Detected),
    Delta_P_positive = as.integer(P_positive) - as.integer(Oracle_P_positive),
    Delta_Mesor_absolute_error_centered = Mesor_absolute_error_centered - Oracle_Mesor_absolute_error_centered,
    Delta_Amplitude_shrunk_absolute_error = Amplitude_shrunk_absolute_error - Oracle_Amplitude_shrunk_absolute_error,
    Delta_Acrophase_error_hour = Acrophase_error_hour - Oracle_Acrophase_error_hour
  )

sensitivity_paired_error <- sensitivity_paired %>%
  group_by(Method, celltype, sigma_bio_hour) %>%
  summarise(
    Mean_delta_Mesor_MAE_centered = mean(Delta_Mesor_absolute_error_centered, na.rm = TRUE),
    Mean_delta_Amplitude_shrunk_MAE = mean(Delta_Amplitude_shrunk_absolute_error, na.rm = TRUE),
    Mean_delta_Acrophase_MAE_hour = mean(Delta_Acrophase_error_hour, na.rm = TRUE),
    Median_delta_Mesor_absolute_error_centered = median(Delta_Mesor_absolute_error_centered, na.rm = TRUE),
    Median_delta_Amplitude_shrunk_absolute_error = median(Delta_Amplitude_shrunk_absolute_error, na.rm = TRUE),
    Median_delta_Acrophase_error_hour = median(Delta_Acrophase_error_hour, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

sensitivity_oracle_summary <- sensitivity_summary %>%
  filter(Method == sensitivity_method_order[1]) %>%
  select(
    celltype,
    sigma_bio_hour,
    Oracle_Power = Power,
    Oracle_Type_I_error = Type_I_error,
    Oracle_Realized_FDP = Realized_FDP
  )

sensitivity_paired_summary <- sensitivity_summary %>%
  filter(Method != sensitivity_method_order[1]) %>%
  left_join(sensitivity_oracle_summary, by = c("celltype", "sigma_bio_hour")) %>%
  mutate(
    Delta_Power = Power - Oracle_Power,
    Delta_Type_I_error = Type_I_error - Oracle_Type_I_error,
    Delta_Realized_FDP = Realized_FDP - Oracle_Realized_FDP
  ) %>%
  left_join(sensitivity_paired_error, by = c("Method", "celltype", "sigma_bio_hour"))

write.csv(sensitivity_paired, file.path(sensitivity_output_dir, "gene_level_paired_vs_oracle.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(sensitivity_paired_summary, file.path(sensitivity_output_dir, "gene_level_paired_summary_vs_oracle.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
sensitivity_paired_summary
```

## 7. Analysis settings
```{r phase-sensitivity-settings}
sensitivity_settings <- data.frame(
  analysis = "plug-in phase sensitivity",
  posterior_propagation = FALSE,
  phase_posterior_Q_available = FALSE,
  gene_model = "infer_gene_param sample-aware restricted-null cluster multiplier score test",
  strata_by = "celltype",
  sample_by = "sample_name",
  sample_boot_by = "ZT",
  sample_bootstrap_draws = 499,
  sample_score_draws = 9999,
  n_worker = 4,
  setseed = 1,
  detection_threshold = "FDR < 0.05",
  type_I_threshold = "P_value < 0.05",
  evaluation_genes = "non-seed genes",
  uniform_weight = "r_cell = 1 input; internally bounded to 0.99",
  note = "sigma_bio_hour is biological phase dispersion; r_cell is Cell-level posterior reliability"
)

sensitivity_function_files <- data.frame(
  file = c(
    "../R/infer_cell_phase.R",
    "../R/infer_gene_param.R"
  ),
  md5 = unname(tools::md5sum(c(
    "../R/infer_cell_phase.R",
    "../R/infer_gene_param.R"
  )))
)

write.csv(sensitivity_settings, file.path(sensitivity_output_dir, "analysis_settings.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(sensitivity_function_files, file.path(sensitivity_output_dir, "function_files.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
sensitivity_settings
```

## Cell-to-Gene
```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)

out_dir <- file.path(input_dir, "cell_to_gene_phase_sensitivity")
dat <- read.csv(file.path(out_dir, "gene_level_phase_sensitivity_long.csv"))

seed <- attr(sensitivity_phase, "seed_genes")
methods <- c("Oracle true phase", "Predicted phase + uniform weight", "ZT-only + uniform weight")

df <- dat %>%
  filter(Method %in% methods, !gene %in% seed) %>%
  group_by(Method, sigma_bio_hour) %>%
  summarise(
    Power = sum(Detected & true_rhythmic) / sum(true_rhythmic),
    Phase_MAE = mean(Acrophase_error_hour[true_rhythmic], na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(Method = factor(Method, levels = methods, labels = c("True phase", "SRB phase", "Sample ZT"))) %>%
  pivot_longer(c(Power, Phase_MAE), names_to = "Metric", values_to = "Value") %>%
  mutate(Metric = factor(Metric, levels = c("Power", "Phase_MAE"),
                         labels = c("Rhythmicity detection power", "Acrophase MAE (h)")))

colors <- c("True phase" = "#101010", "SRB phase" = "#A43B3B", "Sample ZT" = "#9A9A9A")

p <- ggplot(df, aes(x = sigma_bio_hour, y = Value, color = Method, group = Method)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1.1) +
  geom_point(size = 3.2) +
  facet_wrap(~Metric, scales = "free_y", nrow = 1) +
  scale_color_manual(values = colors) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = sort(unique(df$sigma_bio_hour))) +
  labs(x = "Biological phase dispersion (h)", y = NULL) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 16) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "top",
    legend.title = element_blank(),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 16),
    legend.key.width = grid::unit(1.2, "cm"),
    strip.background = element_blank(),
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 25),
    axis.title.x = element_text(face = "bold", size = 18),
    axis.text = element_text(color = "black", size = 15),
    axis.line = element_line(linewidth = 0.7),
    axis.ticks = element_line(linewidth = 0.7),
    panel.spacing = grid::unit(1.5, "cm"),
    plot.margin = margin(15, 15, 15, 15)
  )

p

write.csv(df, file.path(out_dir, "Cell_to_Gene.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
ggsave(file.path(out_dir, "Cell_to_Gene.pdf"), p, width = 13, height = 5.5, device = cairo_pdf, bg = "white")
ggsave(file.path(out_dir, "Cell_to_Gene.png"), p, width = 13, height = 5.5, dpi = 600, bg = "white")
```


## Phase uncertainty
```{r}
library(Matrix)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)

out_dir <- file.path(input_dir, "phase_uncertainty")
dir.create(out_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

source("../R/infer_gene_param.R")

count <- as(readMM(file.path(input_dir, "count_gene_by_cell.mtx")), "CsparseMatrix")
genes <- read.csv(file.path(input_dir, "genes.csv"))
meta <- read.csv(file.path(input_dir, "metadata.csv"))
truth <- read.csv(file.path(dirname(input_dir), "gene_truth.csv"))

rownames(count) <- genes$gene
colnames(count) <- meta$cell
meta <- meta[match(colnames(count), meta$cell), , drop = FALSE]

stopifnot(identical(colnames(count), meta$cell))

truth$is_seed <- tolower(as.character(truth$is_seed)) == "true"
truth$true_rhythmic <- tolower(as.character(truth$true_rhythmic)) == "true"
```

### 1. Cell-phase posterior

```{r}
q_file <- file.path(out_dir, "phase_Q.rds")

if (file.exists(q_file)) {
  phase_result <- readRDS(q_file)
} else {
  code <- readLines("../R/infer_cell_phase.R")
  i <- which(trimws(code) == "return(out)")
  stopifnot(length(i) == 1)

  code <- append(code, c(
    '  attr(out, "Q") <- Q',
    '  attr(out, "grid") <- theta_grid'
  ), after = i - 1L)

  eval(parse(text = code), envir = .GlobalEnv)

  phase <- infer_cell_phase(
    count = count,
    metadata = meta,
    ZT_by = "ZT",
    strata_by = "celltype",
    Species = "mouse",
    min_seed = 0.01,
    family = "NB",
    setseed = 1,
    Verbose = TRUE
  )

  phase_result <- list(
    phase = phase,
    Q = attr(phase, "Q"),
    grid = attr(phase, "grid"),
    seed = attr(phase, "seed_genes")
  )

  saveRDS(phase_result, q_file)
}

phase <- phase_result$phase
Q <- phase_result$Q
grid <- phase_result$grid
seed <- phase_result$seed

stopifnot(identical(as.character(phase$cell), meta$cell))
stopifnot(nrow(Q) == ncol(count), ncol(Q) == length(grid))
stopifnot(max(abs(rowSums(Q) - 1)) < 1e-8)

dim(Q)
head(phase)
```

### 2. Select data

```{r}
ct <- c("CT1", "CT6")
use <- meta$celltype %in% ct

count_use <- count[, use, drop = FALSE]
meta_use <- meta[use, , drop = FALSE]
phase_use <- phase[use, , drop = FALSE]
Q_use <- Q[use, , drop = FALSE]

truth_use <- truth %>%
  filter(celltype %in% ct, !is_seed, !gene_id %in% seed) %>%
  select(gene_id, celltype, true_rhythmic, true_amplitude, true_phase_rad)

stopifnot(identical(colnames(count_use), meta_use$cell))
stopifnot(identical(phase_use$cell, meta_use$cell))

table(meta_use$celltype)
dim(count_use)
```

### 3. phase

```{r}
base_file <- file.path(out_dir, "fixed.rds")

if (file.exists(base_file)) {
  fit_fixed <- readRDS(base_file)
} else {
  fit_fixed <- infer_gene_param(
    count = count_use,
    metadata = meta_use,
    theta_pred = phase_use$theta_pred,
    r_cell = phase_use$r_cell,
    strata_by = "celltype",
    ZT_by = "ZT",
    B = 100,
    n_worker = 4,
    setseed = 1,
    Verbose = TRUE,
    sample_by = "sample_name",
    sample_boot_by = "ZT"
  )

  saveRDS(fit_fixed, base_file)
}

fixed <- fit_fixed$param_long
head(fixed)
```

### 4. Posterior draws

```{r}
n_draw <- 5

for (b in seq_len(n_draw)) {
  file <- file.path(out_dir, paste0("draw_", b, ".rds"))

  if (file.exists(file)) next

  set.seed(100 + b)

  theta_draw <- grid[vapply(
    seq_len(nrow(Q_use)),
    function(i) sample.int(ncol(Q_use), 1, prob = Q_use[i, ]),
    integer(1)
  )]

  fit <- infer_gene_param(
    count = count_use,
    metadata = meta_use,
    theta_pred = theta_draw,
    r_cell = phase_use$r_cell,
    strata_by = "celltype",
    ZT_by = "ZT",
    B = 100,
    n_worker = 4,
    setseed = 1,
    Verbose = TRUE,
    sample_by = "sample_name",
    sample_boot_by = "ZT"
  )

  saveRDS(fit, file)
}
```

### 5. Gene-level comparison

```{r}
fixed <- fixed %>%
  inner_join(truth_use, by = c("gene" = "gene_id", "celltype"))

res <- bind_rows(lapply(seq_len(n_draw), function(b) {
  fit <- readRDS(file.path(out_dir, paste0("draw_", b, ".rds")))

  fit$param_long %>%
    inner_join(fixed, by = c("gene", "celltype"), suffix = c("_draw", "_fixed")) %>%
    mutate(
      Draw = b,
      Phase_error = abs(atan2(
        sin(Phase_draw - true_phase_rad),
        cos(Phase_draw - true_phase_rad)
      )) * 24/(2*pi),
      Amplitude_error = abs(Amplitude_draw - true_amplitude),
      Phase_change = abs(atan2(
        sin(Phase_draw - Phase_fixed),
        cos(Phase_draw - Phase_fixed)
      )) * 24/(2*pi),
      Call_change = (FDR_draw < 0.05) != (FDR_fixed < 0.05)
    )
}))

summary <- res %>%
  group_by(Draw, celltype) %>%
  summarise(
    Phase_MAE = mean(Phase_error[true_rhythmic], na.rm = TRUE),
    Amplitude_MAE = mean(Amplitude_error[true_rhythmic], na.rm = TRUE),
    Phase_change = mean(Phase_change[true_rhythmic], na.rm = TRUE),
    Call_change = mean(Call_change, na.rm = TRUE) * 100,
    .groups = "drop"
  )

write.csv(summary, file.path(out_dir, "summary.csv"), row.names = FALSE)

summary
```

### 6. Plot

```{r}
df <- summary %>%
  pivot_longer(

    Metric = factor(
      Metric,
      levels = c("Phase_MAE", "Amplitude_MAE", "Call_change"),

    )
  )

colors <- c("CT1" = "#A43B3B", "CT6" = "#681515")

p <- ggplot(df, aes(x = Draw, y = Value, color = celltype, group = celltype)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +

  facet_wrap(~Metric, scales = "free_y", nrow = 1) +
  scale_color_manual(values = colors) +

    legend.title = element_blank(),

    strip.background = element_blank(),
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 18),
    axis.title.x = element_text(face = "bold", size = 17),
    axis.text = element_text(color = "black", size = 14),
    panel.spacing = grid::unit(1.2, "cm")
  )

p
```
